title: Understanding the Garbage Collector
contentMd:
Java programmers rarely free memory by hand. The garbage collector tracks which objects are still reachable from running threads and reclaims the rest. This automatic process is one of the reasons Java applications are easier to write than those in languages with manual memory management.

Modern collectors divide the heap into generations. New objects are allocated in the eden space and most die there after a minor collection. Objects that survive several cycles are promoted to the old generation, which is collected less often. A full gc pauses every application thread to reclaim the entire heap, so keeping these pauses short is a constant engineering goal.

Tools like jstat and heap dumps help you see what is happening. If you notice rising old-generation usage, you may have a memory leak where a cache holds references it no longer needs. Tuning the collector is less about magic flags and more about understanding your object lifetime.
contentCn:
Java 程序员很少手动释放内存。垃圾回收器（garbage collector）会跟踪哪些对象仍然被运行中的线程可达，并回收其余部分。这一自动化的机制，正是 Java 应用比那些采用手动内存管理的语言更容易编写的原因之一。

现代收集器把堆划分为不同的代（generation）。新分配的对象先落在 eden 空间（eden space），经过一次 minor GC 后大多就地死亡。经历多轮回收仍然存活的对象会被晋升到老年代（old generation），而老年代的回收频率要低得多。Full GC 会暂停所有应用线程以回收整个堆，因此把这类暂停时间压短始终是一个工程目标。

jstat 和堆转储（heap dump）这类工具能帮你看清运行时到底发生了什么。如果你发现老年代使用率一路上涨，那很可能存在内存泄漏——某个缓存还持有着早已不再需要的引用。调优收集器与其说是靠若干“神奇参数”，不如说是靠理解你的对象生命周期。

title: Threads and Shared State
contentMd:
A thread is the smallest unit of execution that the JVM schedules. When several threads read and write the same field without coordination, you get a data race and results that change between runs. The classic fix is the synchronized keyword, which ensures only one thread enters a block at a time by acquiring the object's monitor.

For higher throughput, the java.util.concurrent package offers richer tools. An executor service manages a pool of worker threads so you do not create one per task. A concurrent hash map allows safe reads and writes without locking the whole structure. A volatile field makes a change visible to other threads immediately, though it does not compose multiple operations atomically.

Concurrency is subtle. A deadlock happens when two threads each hold a lock the other wants. Prefer higher-level constructs and always release locks in a finally block, because an exception must not leave a resource permanently locked.
contentCn:
线程是 JVM 调度的最小执行单元。当多个线程在没有协调的情况下读写同一个字段时，就会产生数据竞争（data race），结果也会在每次运行之间发生变化。经典的解法是 synchronized 关键字，它通过获取对象的监视器（monitor），保证同一时刻只有一个线程能进入代码块。

为了获得更高吞吐量，java.util.concurrent 包提供了更丰富的工具。executor service 管理着一池工作线程（thread pool），你不必为每个任务都新建一个线程。concurrent hash map 允许在不给整个结构加锁的情况下安全地读写。volatile 字段能让修改立即对其他线程可见，但它无法把多个操作组合成一个原子操作。

并发是微妙的。当两个线程各自持有对方想要的锁时，就发生了死锁（deadlock）。优先使用更高抽象层次的并发构件，并且始终在 finally 块中释放锁——异常绝不能导致某个资源被永久锁死。

title: Safe Database Access with JDBC
contentMd:
JDBC is the standard API for talking to a relational database from Java. You obtain a connection from a data source, create a statement, and iterate the result set row by row. The pattern is simple, but raw statements invite a serious security problem.

A prepared statement fixes the SQL structure and binds parameters separately. Because the database compiles the plan once and inserts your values as data, user input cannot change the query meaning. This is the primary defense against SQL injection, and it also improves performance for repeated calls.

Always close connections, statements, and result sets, ideally with try-with-resources so they close even when an exception is thrown. In production you should rarely create connections directly; a connection pool such as HikariCP recycles them so the cost of establishing a session is paid once, not on every request. Batching several inserts into a single prepared statement further reduces network round trips, which matters when you persist thousands of rows in a loop. With these habits, database access stays both safe and efficient.
contentCn:
JDBC 是 Java 与关系型数据库交互的标准 API。你从数据源（data source）拿到一个连接，创建一条 statement，然后逐行遍历结果集（result set）。这个模式本身很简单，但裸写 SQL 会招来一个相当严重的安全问题。

预编译语句（prepared statement）固定了 SQL 的结构，并把参数单独绑定。由于数据库只需编译一次执行计划，再把你的值当作数据插入进去，用户输入就无法改变查询本身的语义。这是防御 SQL 注入最核心的手段，同时对重复调用也能带来性能提升。

务必关闭连接、语句和结果集，最好使用 try-with-resources，这样即便抛出异常它们也会被关闭。在生产环境中，你通常不该直接创建连接；像 HikariCP 这样的连接池会循环复用连接，让建立会话的成本只付一次，而不是每次请求都付。把多条 insert 批量合并到同一个 prepared statement 中还能进一步减少网络往返，这在循环中写入上千行数据时尤其关键。养成这些习惯，数据库访问才能既安全又高效。
titleCn: 用 JDBC 安全地访问数据库

title: Making Operations Atomic
contentMd:
A transaction groups several database operations into a single unit that either fully succeeds or fully fails. Without it, a crash halfway through a transfer could debit one account and never credit the other. Spring's @Transactional annotation wraps your method in such a unit, committing at the end and rolling back on a runtime exception.

The transaction manager coordinates this boundary. When a method calls another annotated method, the propagation setting decides whether to join the existing transaction or start a fresh one. Sometimes you want REQUIRES_NEW so an audit record is written even if the outer work rolls back.

Isolation level controls what concurrent transactions can see. Higher isolation prevents phenomena like dirty reads but can reduce throughput through more locking. Choosing the right level is a trade-off between correctness and performance, and it should be a deliberate decision rather than the default left untouched. Timeouts also matter: a transaction that blocks too long can exhaust the connection pool, so set a reasonable deadline and let it fail fast when the database is slow.
contentCn:
事务（transaction）把多个数据库操作归入同一个单元：要么全部成功，要么全部失败。没有它，一次转账执行到一半发生崩溃，就可能已经从一方账户扣款，却始终没有给对方入账。Spring 的 @Transactional 注解会把你的方法包装进这样一个单元，在方法结束时提交，遇到运行时异常则回滚。

事务管理器（transaction manager）负责协调这条边界。当一个方法调用了另一个同样带注解的方法时，传播行为（propagation）决定了是加入已有事务，还是开启一个全新的事务。有时你需要 REQUIRES_NEW，这样即使外层工作回滚，审计记录依然能够写入。

隔离级别（isolation level）决定了并发事务之间能看到什么。较高的隔离级别能避免脏读之类的现象，但也会带来更多加锁，从而压低吞吐量。选对级别是正确性与性能之间的一次权衡，它应当是一个经过深思熟虑的决定，而不是任由默认值躺在那里不管。超时同样重要：一个阻塞过久的事务可能耗尽连接池，所以要设定合理的截止时间，让它在数据库变慢时快速失败。

title: Processing Data with Streams
contentMd:
The Stream API, introduced in Java 8, lets you express collections processing as a pipeline of operations. You start from a source, apply intermediate steps such as filter and map, and finish with a terminal operation like collect or reduce. The code reads top to bottom and hides the iteration loop.

Intermediate operations are lazy. The stream does not actually walk the data until a terminal operation runs, which means an expensive map is only computed for elements that survive the filter. This lazy evaluation can skip work that would otherwise be wasted.

Parallel streams use a shared fork join pool to process chunks concurrently, but they are not free. Splitting, coordinating, and merging add overhead, and shared mutable state breaks them. For most everyday tasks a sequential stream is clearer and fast enough, so reach for parallelism only when profiling shows a real bottleneck. Another pitfall is side effects: a stream operation should not mutate external state, because the order of execution is not guaranteed. Keep each step pure and let the terminal operation gather the result, and the pipeline stays both correct and easy to reason about.
contentCn:
Java 8 引入的 Stream API，让你把集合处理表达成一条操作流水线。你从一个数据源出发，施加 filter、map 这样的中间步骤，最后以 collect 或 reduce 这样的终端操作收尾。代码自上而下顺读下来，迭代循环被藏了起来。

中间操作是惰性的（lazy）。在终端操作真正执行之前，流并不会实际遍历数据，也就是说昂贵的 map 只会作用在通过 filter 筛选出来的元素上。这种惰性求值能省掉大量本来会被浪费掉的工作。

并行流借助共享的 fork join pool 并发处理数据分块，但它并不是免费的：切分、协同和合并都会带来额外开销，共享可变状态更是直接让它失效。对大多数日常任务来说，顺序流更清晰，速度也够用，只有当性能剖析（profiling）暴露出真正的瓶颈时才值得上并行。另一个坑是副作用：流中的操作不应修改外部状态，因为执行顺序并无保证。让每一步保持纯粹，把结果交给终端操作去收集，整条流水线才能既正确又易于推理。

title: Mapping Objects to Tables
contentMd:
JPA is the standard that lets you persist Java objects without hand-writing SQL for every table. You mark a class as an entity and annotate how its fields map to columns. Hibernate, the most common implementation, generates the queries and tracks changes so an update is flushed automatically.

Lazy loading defers fetching of related collections until you actually touch them, which keeps the first query light. The catch is the N+1 problem: if you loop over a hundred parents and access a lazy child on each, you trigger a hundred extra queries. A join fetch in your repository query solves it by loading the graph in one statement.

Entities should be plain and focused on state. Keep business rules in a service layer and avoid putting database calls inside the entity itself. This separation makes the model easier to test and keeps persistence concerns where they belong. A version field annotated for optimistic locking also prevents two transactions from overwriting each other's changes, which is a common source of subtle bugs in concurrent systems. With that guard in place, the same entity can safely serve both reads and writes.
contentCn:
JPA 让你不必为每张表手写 SQL 就能持久化 Java 对象，是这一领域的标准规范。你把一个类标记为实体（entity），并用注解说明它的字段如何映射到数据库列。最常见的实现 Hibernate 会自动生成查询并跟踪变更，于是更新能够被自动 flush。

延迟加载（lazy loading）把关联集合的读取推迟到你真正访问它们为止，这让第一次查询足够轻量。问题在于 N+1：如果你遍历一百个父对象、并分别访问各自的懒加载子对象，就会额外触发一百次查询。在 repository 查询里使用 join fetch，可以用一条语句把整个对象图加载出来，问题就此解决。

实体应当保持纯粹，只关注状态本身。把业务规则留在 service 层，避免在实体内部直接发起数据库调用。这样的分层让模型更容易测试，也让持久化的关注点各归其位。再加一个标注为乐观锁（optimistic locking）的 version 字段，还能防止两个事务互相覆盖对方的修改——这在并发系统里是隐蔽 bug 的常见来源。有了这层保护，同一个实体就能同时安全地承担读和写。

title: Event Streaming with Kafka
contentMd:
Kafka is a distributed platform for moving events between services. Producers publish records to a topic, and consumers subscribe to read them. Unlike a queue where a message is consumed once, many independent consumer groups can read the same topic, which makes event-driven designs natural.

A topic is split into partitions, and the key you choose decides which partition a record lands on. Records with the same key stay in order, so if you key by user id, all events for one user are processed sequentially. Replication across brokers keeps the data safe when a machine fails.

Consumers track an offset, the position of the next record to read. Because you can reset an offset, you can replay history to rebuild a view or fix a bug. This ability to reprocess the log is what makes event sourcing and audit trails practical in a Java microservice landscape. Producers should also handle the case where the broker is briefly unavailable, using retries and acknowledging only after a record is confirmed, so no important event is silently lost during a network blip.
contentCn:
Kafka 是一个在服务之间传递事件的分布式平台。生产者把消息记录（record）发布到 topic 上，消费者订阅并读取它们。与一条消息只能被消费一次的队列不同，同一个 topic 可以被多个彼此独立的消费者组同时读取，这使得事件驱动的设计显得自然而然。

一个 topic 会被切分成多个分区（partition），而你选择的 key 决定了一条 record 落到哪个分区。key 相同的 record 会保持原有顺序，因此如果你按 user id 作为 key，同一个用户的所有事件就会被顺序处理。broker 之间的副本机制（replication）则保证了机器故障时数据依然安全。

消费者会记录一个 offset，也就是下一条待读取 record 的位置。由于 offset 可以重置，你能够重放历史消息来重建视图或修复缺陷。正是这种重新处理日志的能力，让事件溯源（event sourcing）和审计追踪在 Java 微服务体系下变得切实可行。生产者同样要处理 broker 短暂不可用的情况：加入重试机制，并且只在 record 被确认之后才发送 ack，这样网络抖动时就不会静默丢掉重要事件。
titleCn: 用 Kafka 做事件流处理

title: Staying Resilient Under Failure
contentMd:
In a microservice system, your service depends on others that will occasionally fail or slow down. If every slow call blocks a thread, a single struggling dependency can exhaust the whole pool and take you down with it. Resilience is about degrading gracefully instead of failing completely.

A circuit breaker watches for repeated failures and, once a threshold is crossed, stops calling the dependency and returns a fallback immediately. This fast failure gives the downstream service time to recover and protects your threads. Complementary patterns include retries with backoff and bulkheads that isolate resources so one pool cannot starve another.

Resilience4j provides these patterns as small, composable decorators. Wrapping a remote call with a circuit breaker and a retry is a few lines of code but dramatically changes how the system behaves under stress. Measuring the breaker state through an actuator endpoint lets you see problems before users do. Timeouts are the final piece: every outbound call should have a bound, because an unbounded wait is how a single slow dependency silently consumes your entire thread pool. Together these patterns turn a fragile chain of calls into a system that fails in controlled, recoverable ways.
contentCn:
在微服务系统里，你依赖的其他服务总会偶尔失败或者变慢。如果每一次缓慢的调用都会阻塞一个线程，那么仅仅一个陷入困境的依赖就可能耗尽整个线程池，把你也一起拖垮。韧性要解决的是优雅降级，而不是整体崩盘。

熔断器（circuit breaker）会监测重复出现的失败，一旦越过阈值就停止调用该依赖，并立即返回一个兜底结果。这种快速失败为下游服务留出了恢复时间，也保护了你的线程。与之互补的模式还有带退避的重试（backoff），以及把资源隔离开的舱壁（bulkhead）模式，避免一个资源池把另一个饿死。

Resilience4j 把这些模式封装成小巧、可组合的装饰器。给一次远程调用套上熔断器和重试只需几行代码，却能显著改变系统在压力下的行为。通过 actuator 端点暴露熔断器的状态，可以让问题在你察觉之前先被看到。超时是最后一块拼图：每一次对外调用都应该有上界，因为无期限的等待正是一个缓慢依赖悄悄吃光你整个线程池的方式。合在一起，这些模式把脆弱的调用链变成了一个以受控且可恢复的方式失败的系统。

title: G1 Garbage Collector Explained
contentMd:
G1 (Garbage-First) is the default collector since Java 9 and is designed for multi-core machines with large heaps. Unlike older generational collectors that divide the heap into contiguous young and old spaces, G1 partitions the heap into a set of equal-sized regions (typically 1MB to 32MB). It tracks the live data in each region and builds a priority list sorted by the amount of garbage, hence the name Garbage-First: it reclaims the regions with the most garbage first.

G1 runs in phases. A young collection evacuates the Eden and Survivor regions, copying live objects into new survivor or old regions. Mixed collections target both young and old regions with the highest reclaimable space. Concurrent marking identifies live objects across the heap without stopping the application for long. The defining feature is the pause-time goal: you can set -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 and G1 adapts its region selection to stay within that target.

In interviews, emphasize that G1 reduces the risk of large, unpredictable stop-the-world pauses compared with CMS, while avoiding the fragmentation problems that eventually forced a full GC in CMS. It uses a snapshot-at-the-start (SATB) marking approach and a write barrier to track references. Tuning mainly revolves around heap size, the pause-time target, and region size, rather than manually sizing young and old generations.
contentCn:
G1（Garbage-First，垃圾优先）自 Java 9 起成为默认垃圾回收器，专为拥有大堆内存的多核机器设计。与将堆划分为连续年轻代和老年代的传统分代回收器不同，G1 将堆拆分为一组大小相等的 Region（通常 1MB 到 32MB）。它会统计每个 Region 中存活对象的数量，并按照垃圾多少对 Region 排序，优先回收垃圾最多的 Region，这也是“Garbage-First”名称的由来。

G1 的运行分为多个阶段。年轻代回收（Young GC）会清理 Eden 和 Survivor 区，将存活对象复制到其他 Survivor 或老年代 Region。混合回收（Mixed GC）同时针对年轻代和回收收益最高的老年代 Region。并发标记（Concurrent Marking）在不长时间停顿应用的前提下，识别整个堆中的存活对象。G1 的标志性特性是停顿时间目标：你可以通过 -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 设定期望的最大停顿，G1 会自动调整待回收的 Region 选择，尽量将停顿控制在目标范围内。

在面试中，应重点说明：相比 CMS，G1 降低了出现长时间、不可预测的全停顿风险，同时避免了 CMS 后期因内存碎片而触发 Full GC 的问题。G1 采用 SATB（Snapshot-At-The-Beginning，起始快照）标记算法和写屏障来追踪引用关系。其调优主要围绕堆大小、停顿时间目标以及 Region 尺寸展开，而不再需要手动划分年轻代和老年代的大小。

title: CMS Garbage Collector Explained
contentMd:
CMS (Concurrent Mark Sweep) was a popular low-pause collector used for the old generation before Java 9, often paired with the Parallel collector for the young generation. Its goal was to minimize stop-the-world pauses by doing most of the garbage collection work concurrently with the application threads.

CMS works in several phases. The initial mark pauses all threads briefly to mark objects directly reachable from GC roots. The concurrent mark then traverses the object graph while the application keeps running. A concurrent preclean follows, after which a remark phase pauses threads again to catch changes made during concurrent marking. Finally, concurrent sweep reclaims the dead objects. Because sweeping is concurrent, the application can allocate during collection.

The well-known weakness of CMS is fragmentation. Since it uses mark-sweep rather than compaction, free memory can become scattered into small pieces, eventually causing a “concurrent mode failure” that forces a stop-the-world full GC using the serial collector. CMS was deprecated in Java 9 and removed in later versions; in interviews, explain it as the historical predecessor that motivated G1 and ZGC.
contentCn:
CMS（Concurrent Mark Sweep，并发标记清除）是 Java 9 之前用于老年代的经典低停顿回收器，通常与年轻代的 Parallel 回收器搭配使用。它的目标是通过让垃圾回收的大部分工作与应用线程并发执行，来尽可能缩短 stop-the-world 停顿时间。

CMS 分为多个阶段。初始标记（Initial Mark）会短暂暂停所有线程，标记 GC Roots 直接可达的对象。并发标记（Concurrent Mark）随后在应用继续运行的同时遍历对象图。接着是并发预清理（Concurrent Preclean），随后进入重新标记（Remark）阶段，再次暂停线程以处理并发标记期间产生的变化。最后并发清除（Concurrent Sweep）回收死亡对象。由于清除是并发的，应用在回收期间仍可正常分配内存。

CMS 最著名的缺陷是内存碎片问题。由于它采用标记-清除而非标记-整理算法，空闲内存会逐渐分散为许多小块，最终可能触发“concurrent mode failure”（并发模式失败），被迫使用串行回收器进行一次全停顿的 Full GC。CMS 在 Java 9 中被标记为废弃，并在后续版本中移除；在面试中，应将其理解为催生 G1 与 ZGC 的历史前身。

title: ZGC Garbage Collector Explained
contentMd:
ZGC is a scalable, low-latency garbage collector introduced as an experimental feature in JDK 11 and production-ready from JDK 15. Its headline promise is sub-millisecond pause times that stay nearly constant regardless of heap size, handling multi-terabyte heaps with pauses typically under 10 milliseconds.

ZGC achieves this through colored pointers and load barriers. It stores metadata about an object's state (such as whether it has been remapped or relocated) directly in the unused high bits of the 64-bit pointer itself, rather than in the object header. When the application reads a pointer, a load barrier intercepts the access and, if the object is being relocated, performs the remapping on the fly. This lets ZGC relocate live objects concurrently while the application keeps running.

In interviews, contrast ZGC with G1: both target low pause times, but ZGC's pauses do not grow with heap size or live-set size, making it ideal for latency-sensitive services. It is a regional collector that performs concurrent marking, relocation, and remapping. Limitations include higher CPU and memory overhead, and it is best suited to large heaps where pause time matters more than throughput.
contentCn:
ZGC 是 JDK 11 引入（实验特性）、JDK 15 转为正式可用的高可扩展、低延迟垃圾回收器。它的核心承诺是亚毫秒级停顿，且停顿时间几乎不随堆大小变化，可轻松支撑数 TB 的堆内存，典型停顿通常低于 10 毫秒。

ZGC 通过染色指针（Colored Pointers）和读屏障（Load Barrier）实现这一目标。它将对象状态信息（如对象是否已重映射或已迁移）直接编码在 64 位指针的空闲高位中，而非对象头里。当应用读取一个指针时，读屏障会拦截这次访问，如果对象正在被迁移，则即时完成重映射。这使得 ZGC 能在应用持续运行的同时并发地迁移存活对象。

在面试中，可将 ZGC 与 G1 对比：二者都追求低停顿，但 ZGC 的停顿不会随堆大小或存活集增长而变长，因此特别适合对延迟敏感的服务。它是一个基于 Region 的回收器，能并发完成标记、迁移与重映射。其代价是更高的 CPU 与内存开销，最适合对停顿敏感、且堆内存较大的场景。

title: Generational Heap and the Weak Generational Hypothesis
contentMd:
The Java heap is divided into generations based on the weak generational hypothesis: most objects die young, and the longer an object has survived, the more likely it is to stay alive. This observation lets the JVM optimize collection by treating young and old objects differently.

The young generation holds newly allocated objects and is collected frequently by minor GCs. It is further split into Eden and two Survivor spaces (From and To). Objects are born in Eden; after a minor collection, survivors are copied to a Survivor space and eventually promoted to the old generation if they survive enough cycles. The old generation stores long-lived objects and is collected less often but with more expensive major or mixed collections.

In interviews, explain that generational collection improves efficiency because minor GCs only scan the young region and use cheap copy-based collection. Tuning involves sizing the young generation and understanding promotion: if objects are promoted too quickly, the old generation fills up and triggers costly full GCs. Modern collectors like G1 still use this generational model but with a region-based layout.
contentCn:
Java 堆基于弱分代假说（Weak Generational Hypothesis）进行分代：绝大多数对象“朝生夕死”，而一个对象存活得越久，它继续存活的可能性就越大。基于这一观察，JVM 可以对年轻对象和老年对象采用不同的回收策略，从而提升效率。

年轻代存放新创建的对象，由频繁触发的 Minor GC 回收。它进一步划分为 Eden 区和两块 Survivor 区（From 与 To）。对象诞生于 Eden，在 Minor GC 后存活的对象被复制到 Survivor 区，若经历足够多次回收仍存活，则被晋升到老年代。老年代存放长生命周期对象，回收频率较低，但所触发的 Major GC 或 Mixed GC 代价更高。

在面试中，应说明分代回收之所以高效，是因为 Minor GC 只扫描年轻代，并使用开销较小的复制算法。调优的关键在于合理设置年轻代大小，并理解对象晋升机制：若对象过早晋升，老年代会迅速填满，从而触发代价高昂的 Full GC。G1 等现代回收器仍沿用分代模型，只是改用了基于 Region 的布局。
titleEn: Generational Heap and the Weak Generational Hypothesis
titleCn: 分代堆内存与弱分代假说

title: Class Loading and the Parent-Delegation Model
contentMd:
Java class loading is the process by which the JVM loads a .class file's bytecode into memory and turns it into a usable Class object. This happens lazily: classes are loaded on first use, not all at startup. The process has three phases: loading (finding and reading the bytes), linking (verifying, preparing, and resolving), and initialization (running static initializers).

The JVM uses the parent-delegation model. When a class loader receives a load request, it first delegates upward to its parent before attempting to load the class itself. The hierarchy typically is Bootstrap (loads core JDK classes), Extension/Platform, and Application class loaders. Delegation ensures core classes are loaded only once by the top-most loader, preventing duplicate or malicious replacements of system classes.

In interviews, be ready to explain how custom class loaders and frameworks like Tomcat or Spring Boot break or extend this model for hot deployment and isolation. Also mention that the same class loaded by two different loaders is treated as distinct, which is a common source of ClassCastException and the “Class X cannot be cast to X” error.
contentCn:
Java 类加载是指 JVM 将 .class 文件的字节码读入内存，并转换为可用 Class 对象的过程。它采用懒加载方式：类在首次被使用时才加载，而非在启动时全部加载。整个过程包含三个阶段：加载（查找并读取字节码）、链接（验证、准备、解析）以及初始化（执行静态初始化块）。

JVM 采用双亲委派模型。当一个类加载器收到加载请求时，它会先将请求向上委派给父加载器，父加载器无法完成时，自己才尝试加载。典型层级为：启动类加载器（Bootstrap，从核心模块加载 JDK 基础类）、扩展/平台类加载器，以及应用程序类加载器。双亲委派保证了核心类只会被最顶层加载器加载一次，从而避免系统类被重复加载或被恶意替换。

在面试中，应准备好解释 Tomcat、Spring Boot 等框架如何通过自定义类加载器打破或扩展该模型，以实现热部署与隔离。还要提到：由不同加载器加载的同一个类，在 JVM 中被视为不同的类，这正是 ClassCastException 以及“Class X 无法转换为 X”这类错误常见的根因。
titleEn: Class Loading and the Parent-Delegation Model
titleCn: 类加载机制与双亲委派模型

title: The Java Memory Model (JMM)
contentMd:
The Java Memory Model (JMM) defines how threads interact through memory and what guarantees the JVM makes about visibility and ordering of operations. It does not describe the physical hardware caches; rather, it is an abstraction that lets you reason about concurrent programs correctly across different platforms.

Before the JMM, the classic problem was that a value written by one thread might never become visible to another, or might appear in a different order than written, because of CPU and compiler optimizations such as reordering and caching. The JMM fixes this with happens-before rules: if one action happens-before another, the first is visible to and ordered before the second. Key rules include a program-order rule within a thread, a monitor-lock rule (unlocking happens-before a subsequent lock), and a volatile rule (a write to a volatile variable happens-before subsequent reads).

In interviews, summarize the JMM as a contract: it tells you which memory effects of one thread are guaranteed to be observed by another. Correct concurrency in Java relies on establishing happens-before relationships, typically via synchronized, volatile, or the java.util.concurrent constructs, rather than on assumptions about timing.
contentCn:
Java 内存模型（JMM）定义了线程之间如何通过内存交互，以及 JVM 对操作的可见性与有序性所做出的保证。它并不描述物理硬件层面的缓存，而是一种抽象，使开发者能够在不同平台上正确地推理并发程序的行为。

在 JMM 出现之前，经典问题是：一个线程写入的值可能对另一个线程永远不可见，或者由于 CPU 缓存与编译器重排序等优化，以不同于写入顺序的方式出现。JMM 通过 happens-before（先行发生）规则解决了这一问题：如果操作 A happens-before 操作 B，则 A 的结果对 B 可见，且 A 排在 B 之前。关键规则包括：线程内按程序顺序执行、管程锁规则（解锁 happens-before 后续加锁），以及 volatile 规则（对 volatile 变量的写 happens-before 后续读）。

在面试中，可将 JMM 概括为一份契约：它告诉你一个线程的哪些内存操作能够保证被另一个线程观察到。Java 中正确的并发编程依赖于建立 happens-before 关系，通常通过 synchronized、volatile 或 java.util.concurrent 工具类来实现，而不能依赖对执行时序的假设。

title: volatile, Happens-Before, and Visibility
contentMd:
The volatile keyword is one of the simplest tools for thread-safe communication in Java. Declaring a field volatile guarantees two things: visibility (a write by one thread is immediately visible to other threads) and a limited ordering guarantee (the compiler and CPU will not reorder operations across the volatile read or write in ways that violate the happens-before contract).

Visibility works because a volatile write flushes the value to main memory and a volatile read reloads it from main memory, effectively establishing a happens-before relationship between the write and any subsequent read. This makes volatile suitable for flags, status indicators, and simple counters shared across threads, where atomicity of a single read or write is enough.

However, volatile is not a replacement for synchronization. It does not provide atomicity for compound actions like incrementing a counter (i++ is read-modify-write and is not atomic). In interviews, explain that for such cases you need synchronized, Lock, or atomic classes like AtomicInteger. Use volatile when you only need visibility and a happens-before guarantee, not mutual exclusion.
contentCn:
volatile 是 Java 中用于线程间安全通信最简单的工具之一。将一个字段声明为 volatile 可保证两件事：可见性（一个线程的写入对其他线程立即可见）以及有限的有序性保证（编译器和 CPU 不会以违反 happens-before 契约的方式，将操作重排序到 volatile 读写两侧）。

可见性的实现机制是：volatile 写会将值刷新到主内存，volatile 读会重新从主内存加载该值，从而在写操作与后续任意读操作之间建立起 happens-before 关系。因此，volatile 适用于在线程间共享的标志位、状态指示器以及简单计数器等场景，只要单次读或写的原子性就足够。

然而，volatile 并不能替代同步机制。它无法为自增这类复合操作提供原子性（i++ 是“读取-修改-写入”三步，并非原子操作）。在面试中，应说明此类场景需要使用 synchronized、Lock，或 AtomicInteger 等原子类。只有当需要可见性与 happens-before 保证、而无需互斥时，才使用 volatile。

title: String Intern and the String Pool
contentMd:
In Java, string literals are stored in a special area called the string pool (part of the heap since Java 7), so that identical literal strings share the same object. The intern() method lets you add a runtime-created string to this pool, or retrieve the canonical (pooled) instance if it already exists.

Calling String.intern() checks the pool: if an equal string is present, it returns that existing reference; otherwise it adds the string and returns the new canonical reference. This means s1.intern() == s2.intern() is true whenever the two strings are equal by equals(). Before Java 7 the pool lived in the permanent generation, which was a fixed, easily exhausted space; now it lives in the heap and is bounded by normal heap memory.

In interviews, use intern() carefully. It can reduce memory when you have many duplicate strings, but it introduces a native call and pool management overhead. For most applications the JVM's automatic literal pooling is enough; manual intern() is justified mainly when you intentionally create many equal strings at runtime and want to deduplicate them. Avoid interning unbounded, user-supplied input, which risks memory pressure.
contentCn:
在 Java 中，字符串字面量被存放在一个称为“字符串常量池”的特殊区域（自 Java 7 起位于堆中），使得内容相同的字面量字符串共享同一个对象。intern() 方法允许你将运行时创建的字符串加入该常量池，若池中已存在相等的字符串，则返回其规范化（池化）实例。

调用 String.intern() 会查询常量池：若已存在相等的字符串，则返回该已有引用；否则将其加入池中并返回这个新的规范化引用。这意味着只要两个字符串 equals() 相等，s1.intern() == s2.intern() 就为 true。在 Java 7 之前，常量池位于永久代（Permanent Generation），那是一块固定且容易耗尽的空间；如今它位于堆中，受常规堆内存限制。

在面试中，使用 intern() 需谨慎。它能在存在大量重复字符串时节省内存，但会带来本地方法调用与常量池管理开销。对大多数应用而言，JVM 自动的字面量池化已足够；仅当你在运行时故意创建大量相等字符串并希望去重时，才适合手动调用 intern()。切忌对无限量的用户输入调用 intern()，否则可能引发内存压力。
titleEn: String Intern and the String Pool
titleCn: String intern 与字符串常量池

title: Exception Handling Best Practices
contentMd:
Java distinguishes checked exceptions (Exception subclasses other than RuntimeException) and unchecked exceptions (RuntimeException and Error). Checked exceptions must be declared or caught, which forces the caller to acknowledge potential failures; unchecked exceptions usually indicate programming errors or fatal conditions that the caller cannot reasonably recover from.

A common interview pitfall is catching Exception or Throwable too broadly, which hides bugs and can swallow InterruptedException, breaking thread interruption semantics. Good practice is to catch the most specific exception you can handle, preserve the original cause when wrapping, and never use exceptions for ordinary control flow. Always include the cause when rethrowing so the stack trace remains useful.

Also mention the ‘try-with-resources’ statement (Java 7+) for auto-closing Closeable/AutoCloseable resources, which prevents resource leaks even when an exception is thrown. Finally, consider whether an exception should be checked at all: overusing checked exceptions leads to boilerplate; modern APIs often prefer unchecked exceptions or the ‘Result/Optional’ pattern for expected, recoverable cases.
contentCn:
Java 区分受检异常（除 RuntimeException 外的 Exception 子类）与非受检异常（RuntimeException 与 Error）。受检异常必须被声明或捕获，这迫使调用方正视潜在的失败；非受检异常通常表示编程错误或无法合理恢复的严重状况。

面试中常见的一个陷阱是过于宽泛地捕获 Exception 甚至 Throwable，这会掩盖 bug，并可能吞掉 InterruptedException，从而破坏线程中断语义。良好实践是按能处理的最具体异常进行捕获，在包装异常时保留原始 cause，且绝不要用异常来实现常规控制流。重新抛出时务必带上原始 cause，以保证堆栈信息仍有价值。

还应提及 Java 7 引入的 ‘try-with-resources’ 语句，它可自动关闭 Closeable/AutoCloseable 资源，即使在抛出异常时也能防止资源泄漏。最后，应权衡某异常是否应为受检异常：滥用受检异常会产生大量模板代码，现代 API 往往更倾向于用非受检异常，或针对可预期、可恢复的情况采用 ‘Result/Optional’ 模式。

title: Metaspace and Class Metadata
contentMd:
Metaspace is the native memory area (off the Java heap) where the JVM stores class metadata: method bytecodes, symbols, constant pools, and other structural information. It replaced the Permanent Generation starting in Java 8, and unlike PermGen it is not part of the managed heap.

The key advantage of Metaspace is that it grows dynamically by default, using the available native memory rather than a fixed, easily exhausted size. You can still cap it with -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize to prevent runaway growth from classloader leaks. Because Metaspace is native memory, a leak there does not trigger a normal Java heap GC and can eventually cause an OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace.

In interviews, connect Metaspace to class loading: every loaded class consumes metadata, and a classloader that is never released (for example, in a web app that redeploys repeatedly without freeing loaders) leaks Metaspace. Diagnose such leaks with native memory tracking (-XX:NativeMemoryTracking) and tools like jcmd. The move from PermGen to Metaspace was mainly to reduce out-of-memory errors and simplify tuning.
contentCn:
Metaspace 是一块本地内存区域（位于 Java 堆之外），JVM 在其中存储类元数据：方法字节码、符号、常量池以及其他结构性信息。自 Java 8 起，它取代了永久代（Permanent Generation），且不同于 PermGen，它不属于被管理的堆内存。

Metaspace 的主要优势在于：默认情况下它会动态增长，使用的是可用的本地内存，而非一段固定且容易耗尽的空间。你仍可通过 -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize 为其设定上限，以防类加载器泄漏导致无限膨胀。由于 Metaspace 属于本地内存，其中的泄漏不会触发常规的 Java 堆 GC，最终可能引发 OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace。

在面试中，应将 Metaspace 与类加载联系起来：每个被加载的类都会消耗元数据，若某个类加载器始终未被释放（例如 Web 应用反复重新部署却未释放加载器），就会造成 Metaspace 泄漏。可借助本地内存追踪（-XX:NativeMemoryTracking）与 jcmd 等工具诊断此类泄漏。从 PermGen 迁移到 Metaspace，主要目的是减少内存溢出错误并简化调优。

title: Off-Heap Memory and Direct ByteBuffers
contentMd:
Off-heap memory refers to memory allocated outside the Java heap, managed directly by the OS or through native calls rather than the garbage collector. The most common way to use it in Java is java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(), which creates a direct buffer backed by native memory.

The main benefits are reduced GC pressure and faster I/O. Because direct buffers live outside the heap, copying data to and from channels (such as sockets or files) avoids an extra intermediate copy, which is why high-performance frameworks like Netty use them heavily. They also survive GC cycles without being moved, simplifying interaction with native code.

The trade-offs matter in interviews. Off-heap memory is not automatically reclaimed by the GC; the associated Java object is collected, but the underlying native memory is released only when the cleaner or reference queue runs, which can lag. Large or unbounded off-heap allocations risk an OutOfMemoryError even when the heap looks healthy. Tune with -XX:MaxDirectMemorySize and always monitor both heap and native memory when diagnosing leaks.
contentCn:
堆外内存（Off-heap Memory）指在 Java 堆之外分配的内存，由操作系统或通过本地调用直接管理，而不受垃圾回收器管辖。Java 中使用堆外内存最常见的方式是 java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocateDirect()，它创建一个由本地内存支撑的直接缓冲区。

其主要优势在于降低 GC 压力并提升 I/O 性能。由于直接缓冲区位于堆外，在与通道（如 socket 或文件）之间传输数据时可以避免一次额外的中间拷贝，这正是 Netty 等高性能框架大量使用它的原因。它们也不会在 GC 周期中被移动，从而简化了与本地代码的交互。

这些权衡在面试中十分关键。堆外内存不会被 GC 自动回收：对应的 Java 对象虽可被回收，但底层本地内存往往要等到 cleaner 或引用队列运行时才释放，可能明显滞后。大量或无节制的堆外分配，即使堆内存看似健康，也可能引发 OutOfMemoryError。应通过 -XX:MaxDirectMemorySize 进行限制，并在排查泄漏时同时监控堆内存与本地内存。

title: Stop-The-World and GC Pause Times
contentMd:
A stop-the-world (STW) event is a period during which all application threads are paused so the JVM can perform a safe operation, most commonly garbage collection. The length and frequency of these pauses directly affect an application's responsiveness and tail latency.

Why must threads stop? Garbage collection often needs a consistent view of the object graph to identify live objects accurately. If application threads kept mutating references during collection, the collector could miss live objects or free in-use memory. Safepoints are the mechanism: the JVM asks threads to pause at well-defined points, and a GC starts only when all threads reach a safepoint.

In interviews, compare collectors by their STW behavior. Serial and Parallel collectors pause for the entire collection; CMS and G1 aim to keep pauses short by doing most work concurrently, though they still have brief STW phases for marking roots and remarking. ZGC and Shenandoah go furthest, keeping almost all work concurrent so pauses stay under a millisecond regardless of heap size. Tuning GC is essentially managing the trade-off between throughput and pause time.
contentCn:
Stop-the-World（STW，全停顿）是指所有应用线程被暂停，以便 JVM 执行某项安全操作（最常见的是垃圾回收）的一段时间。这些停顿的时长与频率，直接影响应用的响应速度与时延尾部表现。

为何必须暂停线程？垃圾回收通常需要对对象图有一致性的观察，才能准确识别存活对象。若应用线程在回收过程中持续修改引用，回收器可能漏掉存活对象，或错误地释放正在使用的内存。安全点（Safepoint）正是实现机制：JVM 要求线程在定义良好的位置暂停，只有当所有线程都到达安全点后，GC 才会启动。

在面试中，可依据 STW 行为对比不同回收器。Serial 与 Parallel 回收器在整个回收过程中都会停顿；CMS 与 G1 通过将大部分工作并发化来缩短停顿，但仍保留标记根、重新标记等短暂的 STW 阶段。ZGC 与 Shenandoah 走得最远，几乎将全部工作并发化，使停顿无论堆多大都控制在毫秒以内。GC 调优本质上就是在吞吐量与停顿时间之间做权衡。
titleCn: Stop-The-World 与 GC 停顿时间

title: Core Garbage Collection Algorithms
contentMd:
Behind every collector is a small set of fundamental algorithms. Mark-Sweep finds live objects by tracing from GC roots, then reclaims the unmarked space. It is simple but leaves fragmentation because it does not move objects. Mark-Compact adds a compaction step that slides live objects together, eliminating fragmentation at the cost of extra time and a usually stop-the-world phase.

Copying collection splits memory into two halves (or, in generational collectors, Eden and Survivor spaces). It copies live objects from the source space to the destination and discards the entire source at once. This is fast and automatically compacted, but it needs extra free space to copy into and is therefore ideal for the young generation where most objects die.

In interviews, explain that modern collectors compose these building blocks. G1 uses region-based copying for young collections and marking plus partial compaction for old regions. The choice of algorithm depends on object lifetime and pause goals. Understanding these basics lets you reason about why tuning parameters behave the way they do and what trade-offs each collector makes.
contentCn:
每个垃圾回收器背后，都是一组基础的算法。标记-清除（Mark-Sweep）从 GC Roots 出发追踪存活对象，随后回收未被标记的空间。它实现简单，但因不移动对象而会产生内存碎片。标记-整理（Mark-Compact）额外增加了一个整理步骤，将存活对象滑动靠拢，消除了碎片，代价是额外的耗时与一个通常需要的 STW 阶段。

复制（Copying）算法将内存分为两半（或在分代回收器中对应 Eden 与 Survivor 区）。它将存活对象从源空间复制到目标空间，然后一次性丢弃整个源空间。这种方式速度快且天然具备压缩效果，但需要额外的空闲空间用于复制，因此最适合对象大多“朝生夕死”的年轻代。

在面试中，应说明现代回收器是对这些基础模块的组合运用。G1 在年轻代回收时采用基于 Region 的复制算法，对老年代 Region 则采用标记加部分整理。算法的选择取决于对象生命周期与停顿目标。理解这些基础，才能解释调优参数背后的行为逻辑，以及各回收器所做的取舍。

title: Strong, Soft, Weak, and Phantom References
contentMd:
Java offers four reference strengths that control how the garbage collector treats an object. A strong reference is the normal ‘new’ reference; as long as it exists, the object is never collected. SoftReference points to objects the GC may reclaim when memory is low, making it perfect for memory-sensitive caches. WeakReference is collected on the very next GC regardless of memory pressure, which is how ThreadLocal and WeakHashMap avoid leaks.

PhantomReference is the weakest; its referent is never accessed directly and it exists mainly to receive a notification (via a reference queue) after the object has been finalized and is about to be reclaimed. Unlike the others, you must always pair a PhantomReference with a ReferenceQueue. It is commonly used for fine-grained cleanup of native resources.

In interviews, the key distinctions are reachability and collection timing. Soft references survive until memory is tight, weak references die at the next collection, and phantom references are about post-mortem notification rather than access. Mentioning ThreadLocal's use of weak references and the risk of value leaks shows deeper understanding of real-world pitfalls.
contentCn:
Java 提供了四种引用强度，用以控制垃圾回收器对待对象的方式。强引用（Strong Reference）即普通的 new 引用，只要它存在，对象就绝不会被回收。软引用（SoftReference）指向的对象在内存不足时才会被 GC 回收，因此非常适合用于内存敏感的缓存。弱引用（WeakReference）无论内存是否紧张，都会在下次 GC 时被回收，ThreadLocal 与 WeakHashMap 正是借此避免泄漏。

虚引用（PhantomReference）是最弱的一种，其指向的对象永远无法直接访问，它存在的主要意义是在对象被终结、即将回收时通过引用队列收到通知。与其他引用不同，虚引用必须始终与 ReferenceQueue 配对使用，常用于对本地资源进行精细化的清理。

在面试中，关键在于区分可达性与回收时机：软引用会一直存活到内存吃紧，弱引用在下一次回收时消亡，而虚引用关注的是“死后”通知而非访问。若能进一步提及 ThreadLocal 使用弱引用、以及可能造成 value 泄漏的风险，则更能体现对真实陷阱的深入理解。
titleEn: Strong, Soft, Weak, and Phantom References
titleCn: 强引用、软引用、弱引用与虚引用

title: JVM Memory Structure: Stack vs Heap
contentMd:
Every Java thread gets its own call stack, while the heap is shared across all threads. The stack stores method frames containing local primitive variables, object references, and the call chain; it is small, fast, and automatically reclaimed when methods return. The heap stores the actual objects and is managed by the garbage collector.

A common confusion is where objects live. The object itself always lives on the heap, but the reference to it lives on the stack (or in another object on the heap). When you pass an object to a method, you are passing the reference by value, not copying the object. This is why modifications to an object's fields inside a method are visible to the caller.

In interviews, also mention that beyond stack and heap, the JVM has the method area (now Metaspace), the program counter register, and native method stacks. StackOverflowError happens when the stack depth exceeds its limit (typically infinite recursion), while OutOfMemoryError relates to exhausting the heap or other memory areas. Knowing these boundaries helps you reason about both performance and failure modes.
contentCn:
每个 Java 线程都拥有自己独立的调用栈，而堆（Heap）则由所有线程共享。栈中存放方法栈帧，包含局部基本类型变量、对象引用以及调用链；它空间较小、速度很快，并在方法返回时自动回收。堆中存放真正的对象实例，由垃圾回收器管理。

一个常见的混淆点在于对象究竟存放在哪里。对象本身始终位于堆中，而指向它的引用则位于栈上（或位于堆中的另一个对象内）。当把对象传入方法时，传递的是引用的值，而非对象的副本。这也解释了为何在方法内部修改对象的字段，调用方能够看到这些改动。

在面试中，还应提及除栈与堆之外，JVM 还有方法区（如今即 Metaspace）、程序计数器以及本地方法栈。当栈深度超过限制（典型如无限递归）时会抛出 StackOverflowError，而 OutOfMemoryError 则与堆或其他内存区域的耗尽有关。厘清这些边界，有助于你推理性能问题与故障模式。
titleEn: JVM Memory Structure: Stack vs Heap

title: HashMap vs ConcurrentHashMap
contentMd:
HashMap is the most commonly used implementation of the Map interface, offering O(1) average-time get and put operations. However, it is not thread-safe. If multiple threads modify a HashMap concurrently, especially during structural modifications such as put or remove, the internal structure can become corrupted and the iteration may throw a ConcurrentModificationException due to the fail-fast iterator.

ConcurrentHashMap, introduced in Java 5 and redesigned in Java 8, provides thread safety without locking the entire map. In Java 8 it uses an array of Node buckets, and each bucket is locked independently using a technique called lock striping combined with CAS (Compare-And-Swap) for insertion. Reads are generally lock-free, which makes concurrent reads very efficient. This allows many threads to read and write different segments of the map simultaneously.

Use HashMap when you do not need concurrent access, since it has the lowest overhead. Choose ConcurrentHashMap when multiple threads share a map and you want safe concurrent updates without the heavy synchronization cost of a fully locked Collections.synchronizedMap. Avoid using Hashtable, which locks the entire object on every method and is largely obsolete. Remember that ConcurrentHashMap does not support null keys or values, whereas HashMap does.
contentCn:
HashMap 是 Map 接口最常用的实现，提供 O(1) 平均时间复杂度的 get 和 put 操作。但它并非线程安全。如果多个线程并发修改 HashMap，尤其是在 put 或 remove 等结构性修改时，内部结构可能被破坏，并且由于 fail-fast（快速失败）迭代器，迭代过程可能抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。

ConcurrentHashMap 在 Java 5 中引入，并在 Java 8 中重新设计，它在不需要锁住整个映射的前提下提供了线程安全性。在 Java 8 中，它使用一个 Node 桶数组，每个桶通过称为分段锁（lock striping）的技术结合 CAS（比较并交换）进行独立加锁来实现插入操作。读取操作通常是无锁的，因此并发读取非常高效。这使得多个线程可以同时读写映射的不同部分。

当你不需要并发访问时，使用 HashMap，因为它的开销最低。当多个线程共享一个映射、且希望在不承受完全加锁的 Collections.synchronizedMap 高昂同步代价的情况下进行安全并发更新时，应选择 ConcurrentHashMap。应避免使用 Hashtable，因为它在每个方法上都会锁住整个对象，已基本被淘汰。注意 ConcurrentHashMap 不支持 null 键或值，而 HashMap 支持。

title: ArrayList vs LinkedList
contentMd:
ArrayList and LinkedList are two common implementations of the List interface, but they have very different internal structures. ArrayList is backed by a dynamic array, while LinkedList is implemented as a doubly linked list where each element holds references to both its previous and next nodes.

Because of these structures, their performance characteristics differ. ArrayList provides O(1) random access by index, but inserting or deleting elements in the middle requires shifting subsequent elements, costing O(n). LinkedList offers O(1) insertion and deletion at the head or tail (when you have a node reference), but random access requires traversing the list, costing O(n).

In practice, ArrayList is almost always the better default choice because modern CPUs cache contiguous memory very efficiently, and most real-world code reads more than it mutates in the middle. Use LinkedList only when you need frequent insertions and deletions at both ends, such as implementing a queue or deque. Otherwise, prefer ArrayList.
contentCn:
ArrayList 和 LinkedList 是 List 接口的两种常见实现，但它们的内部结构截然不同。ArrayList 由动态数组支撑，而 LinkedList 被实现为双向链表，每个元素都持有指向前一个和后一个节点的引用。

由于结构不同，它们的性能特征也有所差异。ArrayList 通过下标提供 O(1) 的随机访问，但在中间插入或删除元素需要移动后续元素，代价为 O(n)。LinkedList 在头部或尾部（当你持有节点引用时）提供 O(1) 的插入和删除，但随机访问需要遍历链表，代价为 O(n)。

在实践中，ArrayList 几乎总是更好的默认选择，因为现代 CPU 能非常高效地缓存连续内存，而且大多数真实代码的读取操作多于在中间位置的修改。仅当你需要频繁在两端进行插入和删除（例如实现队列或双端队列）时才使用 LinkedList。否则，应优先选择 ArrayList。

title: Fail-Fast vs Fail-Safe Iterators
contentMd:
A fail-fast iterator fails as soon as it detects that the collection has been structurally modified after the iterator was created, throwing a ConcurrentModificationException. Most iterators returned by standard Java collections such as ArrayList, HashMap, and HashSet are fail-fast. They track a modification count (modCount) and compare it during iteration.

A fail-safe iterator operates on a copy of the collection rather than the original, so it never throws ConcurrentModificationException even if the underlying collection changes during iteration. Iterators from concurrent collections such as CopyOnWriteArrayList and ConcurrentHashMap are effectively fail-safe, but they may not reflect the most recent changes made by other threads.

The trade-off is that fail-fast gives you immediate visibility of a bug but can abort iteration, while fail-safe avoids exceptions at the cost of potentially stale data and extra memory for the copy. In interviews, emphasize that fail-fast is about detecting concurrent modification, not guaranteeing thread safety, and that the best practice is to avoid modifying a collection while iterating over it.
contentCn:
fail-fast（快速失败）迭代器在检测到集合自迭代器创建后被结构性修改时，会立即失败并抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。ArrayList、HashMap 和 HashSet 等标准 Java 集合返回的迭代器大多是 fail-fast 的。它们跟踪一个修改计数（modCount）并在迭代过程中进行比较。

fail-safe（安全失败）迭代器操作的是集合的副本而非原集合，因此即使底层集合在迭代期间发生变化，也不会抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。CopyOnWriteArrayList 和 ConcurrentHashMap 等并发集合的迭代器本质上是 fail-safe 的，但它们可能无法反映其他线程所做的最新修改。

二者的权衡在于：fail-fast 能让你立即发现错误，但可能会中断迭代；而 fail-safe 以避免异常为代价，可能导致读取到过期数据，并因复制而产生额外的内存开销。在面试中，要强调 fail-fast 是为了检测并发修改，而非保证线程安全，最佳实践是在迭代集合时不要对其进行修改。
titleCn: 快速失败与安全失败迭代器

title: Thread vs Runnable
contentMd:
In Java, there are two classic ways to define a task to be executed by a thread: extending the Thread class or implementing the Runnable interface. Extending Thread couples your task with the thread mechanism itself, while implementing Runnable separates the task logic from the thread that runs it.

The recommended approach is to implement Runnable (or Callable) and pass it to a Thread or, better, to an ExecutorService. This keeps your code flexible: you can run the same Runnable in a thread, a thread pool, or a scheduled executor. It also avoids the single-inheritance limitation of Java, since a class that implements Runnable can still extend another class.

Modern Java favors higher-level abstractions. Since Java 5, prefer ExecutorService and tasks that implement Runnable or Callable over manually creating Thread objects. Since Java 8, you can pass a lambda expression directly where a Runnable is expected, making the code more concise and readable.
contentCn:
在 Java 中，定义由线程执行的任务有两种经典方式：继承 Thread 类或实现 Runnable 接口。继承 Thread 会将你的任务与线程机制本身耦合在一起，而实现 Runnable 则将任务逻辑与运行它的线程分离开来。

推荐的做法是实现 Runnable（或 Callable）接口，并将其传递给一个 Thread，或者更好的是传递给 ExecutorService。这样代码更灵活：同一个 Runnable 可以在线程、线程池或定时执行器中运行。它还避免了 Java 单继承的限制，因为实现了 Runnable 的类仍然可以继承另一个类。

现代 Java 更偏好高层次的抽象。自 Java 5 起，应优先使用 ExecutorService 以及实现 Runnable 或 Callable 的任务，而不是手动创建 Thread 对象。自 Java 8 起，你可以直接在需要 Runnable 的地方传入 lambda 表达式，使代码更简洁、可读性更强。

title: synchronized vs ReentrantLock
contentMd:
Both synchronized and ReentrantLock provide mutual exclusion, but they differ in flexibility. The synchronized keyword is built into the language, easy to use, and automatically releases the lock when the method or block exits, even via an exception. It is a reentrant lock managed entirely by the JVM.

ReentrantLock, part of the java.util.concurrent.locks package, offers more advanced features. It supports a non-blocking tryLock, lock attempts with a timeout, interruptible lock acquisition, and the ability to create fair locks. You must explicitly call unlock in a finally block, which makes it more error-prone but also more controllable.

In general, prefer synchronized for simple critical sections because it is simpler and less error-prone. Reach for ReentrantLock when you need features such as timed or interruptible locking, or strict fairness guarantees. Note that synchronized has been heavily optimized in modern JVMs, so its performance gap with ReentrantLock is often negligible for basic use.
contentCn:
synchronized 和 ReentrantLock 都提供互斥能力，但在灵活性上有所不同。synchronized 关键字是语言内建的，使用简单，并且在方法或代码块退出时（即使通过异常）会自动释放锁。它是由 JVM 完全管理的可重入锁。

ReentrantLock 属于 java.util.concurrent.locks 包，提供了更先进的功能。它支持非阻塞的 tryLock、带超时的加锁尝试、可中断的加锁获取，以及创建公平锁的能力。你必须在 finally 块中显式调用 unlock，这使得它更容易出错，但也更可控。

一般来说，对于简单的临界区应优先使用 synchronized，因为它更简单且不易出错。当你需要带超时或可中断的加锁，或严格的公平性保证时，再使用 ReentrantLock。注意，现代 JVM 已对 synchronized 做了大量优化，因此在基本用途上它与 ReentrantLock 的性能差距通常可以忽略不计。

title: ReentrantLock and AQS Internals
contentMd:
ReentrantLock is built on top of the AbstractQueuedSynchronizer (AQS), the foundational framework for most locks and synchronizers in java.util.concurrent. AQS manages a FIFO queue of threads waiting to acquire a lock and an integer state field that represents the synchronization state.

When a thread tries to acquire the lock, AQS uses a CAS operation to atomically update the state. If it succeeds, the thread becomes the owner; if it fails, the thread is wrapped into a node and parked (suspended) at the tail of the wait queue. When the owner releases the lock, AQS wakes the next waiting thread in the queue.

A key insight for interviews is that AQS separates the queuing and waking mechanics from the policy. Subclasses like ReentrantLock only decide how state is acquired and released (for example, tracking reentrant hold counts), while AQS handles the hard part of efficiently and fairly scheduling threads. This design is why many concurrent utilities share similar, well-tested behavior.
contentCn:
ReentrantLock 构建在 AbstractQueuedSynchronizer（AQS，抽象队列同步器）之上，AQS 是 java.util.concurrent 中大多数锁和同步器的基础框架。AQS 管理一个等待获取锁的线程的 FIFO 队列，并维护一个表示同步状态的整数 state 字段。

当线程尝试获取锁时，AQS 使用 CAS 操作来原子地更新状态。如果成功，该线程成为锁的持有者；如果失败，线程会被包装成一个节点，并 park（挂起）在等待队列的尾部。当持有者释放锁时，AQS 会唤醒队列中的下一个等待线程。

面试中的一个关键认知是，AQS 将排队和唤醒机制与策略分离开来。ReentrantLock 等子类只决定如何获取和释放状态（例如记录可重入的持有计数），而 AQS 负责高效地、公平地调度线程这一难题。正是由于这种设计，许多并发工具才共享相似且经过充分测试的底层行为。
titleCn: ReentrantLock 与 AQS 内部机制

title: Thread Pools and ExecutorService
contentMd:
A thread pool reuses a fixed number of threads to execute many tasks, avoiding the high cost of repeatedly creating and destroying threads. In Java, the ExecutorService interface and the Executors factory class provide convenient ways to create pools such as fixed-size, cached, and single-thread executors.

The most important parameters live in ThreadPoolExecutor: corePoolSize, maximumPoolSize, keepAliveTime, a work queue, and a thread factory plus rejection policy. When a task arrives, the pool creates core threads up to corePoolSize, then queues the task, and only creates extra threads up to maximumPoolSize when the queue is full. If everything is saturated, the rejection policy (such as AbortPolicy) handles it.

In production, avoid the convenient Executors.newFixedThreadPool and newCachedThreadPool because they use unbounded queues or unbounded thread counts that can exhaust memory. Prefer constructing a ThreadPoolExecutor explicitly with a bounded queue and a sensible rejection policy, and always remember to call shutdown() to release resources.
contentCn:
线程池复用固定数量的线程来执行大量任务，从而避免反复创建和销毁线程的高昂代价。在 Java 中，ExecutorService 接口和 Executors 工厂类提供了创建线程池的便捷方式，例如固定大小、缓存型和单线程执行器。

最重要的参数都在 ThreadPoolExecutor 中：corePoolSize（核心线程数）、maximumPoolSize（最大线程数）、keepAliveTime（空闲线程存活时间）、一个工作队列，以及线程工厂和拒绝策略。当任务到达时，线程池会先创建核心线程直到达到 corePoolSize，然后将任务入队；只有当队列满时，才会创建额外的线程直至 maximumPoolSize。如果一切都已饱和，拒绝策略（如 AbortPolicy）会处理它。

在生产环境中，应避免使用便捷的 Executors.newFixedThreadPool 和 newCachedThreadPool，因为它们分别使用了无界队列或无界线程数，可能导致内存耗尽。应优先显式构造 ThreadPoolExecutor，使用有界队列和合理的拒绝策略，并且始终记得调用 shutdown() 来释放资源。

title: Asynchronous Composition with CompletableFuture
contentMd:
CompletableFuture, introduced in Java 8, represents a future result of an asynchronous computation and provides a rich API for composing tasks without blocking. Unlike the older Future, it lets you chain callbacks such as thenApply, thenAccept, and thenCompose, and combine multiple futures with allOf or anyOf.

A common interview use case is calling several downstream services in parallel and aggregating their results. You can launch each call with CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, then use thenCombine to merge two results, or CompletableFuture.allOf to wait for all of them and then assemble the final response.

Be careful with thread pools: by default, async methods run on the shared ForkJoinPool.commonPool(), which can be exhausted by long-running or blocking tasks. For I/O-bound work, supply your own Executor. Also handle errors with exceptionally or handle, and always decide explicitly whether you want the result synchronously via join or get, or purely asynchronous pipelines.
contentCn:
CompletableFuture 在 Java 8 中引入，表示一个异步计算未来的结果，并提供丰富的 API 用于组合任务而无需阻塞。与较早的 Future 不同，它允许你链式调用 thenApply、thenAccept、thenCompose 等回调，并通过 allOf 或 anyOf 将多个 future 组合在一起。

面试中常见的使用场景是并行调用多个下游服务并聚合其结果。你可以用 CompletableFuture.supplyAsync 启动每个调用，然后使用 thenCombine 合并两个结果，或用 CompletableFuture.allOf 等待所有调用完成后再组装最终响应。

要小心线程池：默认情况下，异步方法运行在共享的 ForkJoinPool.commonPool() 上，而长时间运行或阻塞型任务可能耗尽它。对于 I/O 密集型任务，应提供你自己的 Executor。同时要用 exceptionally 或 handle 来处理错误，并明确决定是要通过 join 或 get 同步获取结果，还是纯粹使用异步流水线。
titleCn: 使用 CompletableFuture 进行异步编排

title: CAS and Lock-Free Programming
contentMd:
CAS, or Compare-And-Swap, is a CPU-level atomic instruction that updates a variable only if its current value equals an expected value, returning whether the swap succeeded. It is the foundation of lock-free programming in Java and underpins classes in the java.util.concurrent.atomic package.

The typical pattern is a loop: read the current value, compute the new value, and attempt CAS; if another thread changed the value meanwhile, the CAS fails and the loop retries with the fresh value. This is called optimistic locking because threads do not block each other but retry on conflict.

CAS avoids the overhead of locking but is not free. It can suffer from the ABA problem, where a value changes from A to B and back to A, making CAS think nothing changed. AtomicStampedReference solves this by pairing the value with a version stamp. Also, heavy contention can cause many retries, so CAS shines best under low to moderate contention.
contentCn:
CAS（Compare-And-Swap，比较并交换）是一种 CPU 级别的原子指令，它仅当变量的当前值等于预期值时才更新该变量，并返回交换是否成功。它是 Java 中无锁编程的基础，也是 java.util.concurrent.atomic 包中各类的底层支撑。

典型模式是一个循环：读取当前值，计算新值，然后尝试 CAS；如果期间另一个线程修改了该值，CAS 就会失败，循环会用最新的值重试。这被称为乐观锁，因为线程之间不会相互阻塞，而是在冲突时重试。

CAS 避免了加锁的开销，但并非没有代价。它可能遭遇 ABA 问题，即某个值从 A 变为 B 又变回 A，使 CAS 误以为没有发生变化。AtomicStampedReference 通过将值与版本戳配对来解决这个问题。此外，在高度竞争下可能导致大量重试，因此 CAS 在低到中等竞争程度下表现最佳。

title: Atomic Classes in Java
contentMd:
The java.util.concurrent.atomic package provides lock-free, thread-safe variables for single-value atomic operations. Common classes include AtomicInteger, AtomicLong, AtomicBoolean, and AtomicReference, each offering methods such as getAndIncrement, compareAndSet, and lazySet.

These classes are useful for counters, flags, and simple state that must be updated safely by multiple threads. For example, an AtomicInteger hit counter can be incremented concurrently without explicit synchronization, and the operation is performed with a fast CAS instruction rather than a heavyweight lock.

For aggregated or field-level atomicity, consider LongAdder when high contention is expected, because it spreads updates across multiple cells to reduce contention. Also note AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater and the newer VarHandle API for fine-grained, low-overhead access to volatile fields. Choose atomic classes over synchronized when you only need to atomically update a single variable.
contentCn:
java.util.concurrent.atomic 包为单值原子操作提供了无锁、线程安全的变量。常见的类包括 AtomicInteger、AtomicLong、AtomicBoolean 和 AtomicReference，它们各自提供了 getAndIncrement、compareAndSet 和 lazySet 等方法。

这些类非常适用于必须由多个线程安全更新的计数器、标志位和简单状态。例如，AtomicInteger 形式的访问计数器可以被并发地递增而无需显式同步，并且该操作是通过快速的 CAS 指令而非重量级锁来完成的。

当预期会有高度竞争时，对于聚合或字段级别的原子性，可考虑使用 LongAdder，因为它将更新分散到多个单元格中以减少竞争。另外，还有 AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater 以及更新的 VarHandle API，用于以细粒度、低开销的方式访问 volatile 字段。当你只需要原子地更新单个变量时，应优先选择原子类而非 synchronized。

title: Deadlock Causes and Prevention
contentMd:
A deadlock occurs when two or more threads are blocked forever, each waiting for a resource held by the other. In Java, deadlocks most often arise from nested synchronized blocks that acquire multiple locks in inconsistent orders across threads.

For example, if thread A locks resource X then tries to lock Y, while thread B locks Y then tries to lock X, the two may each hold one lock and wait indefinitely for the other. Deadlocks require four conditions: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait. Breaking any one prevents the deadlock.

Prevention techniques include always acquiring locks in a consistent global order, using a single lock for related resources, preferring timed tryLock with ReentrantLock, and keeping synchronized blocks as small as possible. At runtime you can detect deadlocks using jstack or JConsole, which can dump thread states and reveal the cycle of waiting threads.
contentCn:
死锁是指两个或多个线程永远相互阻塞，各自等待对方持有的资源。在 Java 中，死锁最常源于以不一致的顺序跨线程获取多个锁的嵌套 synchronized 代码块。

例如，如果线程 A 先锁住资源 X 再尝试锁住 Y，而线程 B 先锁住 Y 再尝试锁住 X，两者可能各自持有一把锁并无限等待对方。死锁需要满足四个条件：互斥、持有并等待、不可抢占，以及循环等待。打破其中任意一个即可防止死锁。

预防技术包括：始终以一致的全局顺序获取锁、对相关资源使用单一锁、优先使用 ReentrantLock 的带超时 tryLock，以及尽可能缩小 synchronized 代码块的范围。在运行时，你可以使用 jstack 或 JConsole 检测死锁，它们可以导出线程状态并揭示等待线程的循环依赖。

title: ThreadLocal and Its Pitfalls
contentMd:
ThreadLocal provides thread-local variables: each thread that accesses a ThreadLocal gets its own, independently initialized copy of the variable. It is commonly used to hold per-thread state such as a database connection, a user session, or a SimpleDateFormat instance, which is not thread-safe.

Internally, each Thread has a ThreadLocalMap, and the ThreadLocal object acts as the key. When a thread calls get or set, the value is stored in that thread's own map, so no locking is needed and there is no contention between threads.

The classic pitfall is memory leaks in server applications using thread pools. Because pooled threads live long and reuse their ThreadLocalMap, values set but never removed can accumulate. Always call remove() in a finally block when you are done, especially in web frameworks where the same thread handles many requests across different users.
contentCn:
ThreadLocal 提供线程局部变量：每个访问 ThreadLocal 的线程都会获得该变量属于自己的、独立初始化的副本。它常用于保存每个线程的状态，例如数据库连接、用户会话，以及非线程安全的 SimpleDateFormat 实例。

在内部，每个 Thread 都有一个 ThreadLocalMap，而 ThreadLocal 对象充当其中的键。当线程调用 get 或 set 时，值被存储在该线程自己的 map 中，因此不需要加锁，线程之间也不存在竞争。

经典的陷阱是在使用线程池的服务器应用中发生内存泄漏。由于池化线程存活时间长且会复用其 ThreadLocalMap，被设置却从未被移除的值会不断累积。使用完毕后务必在 finally 块中调用 remove()，尤其是在同一个线程会处理来自不同用户多个请求的 Web 框架中。

title: CopyOnWriteArrayList Explained
contentMd:
CopyOnWriteArrayList is a thread-safe List implementation where all mutating operations (add, set, remove) create a fresh copy of the underlying array. Reads operate on the current snapshot without any locking, which makes reads extremely cheap and safe under concurrency.

This design is ideal for read-heavy, write-rarely scenarios such as listener lists or configuration caches, where iteration happens far more often than modification. Because the iterator works on a snapshot taken at creation time, it is fail-safe and never throws ConcurrentModificationException.

The trade-off is memory and latency: every write copies the entire array, so writes are O(n) and can be expensive under frequent updates. Also, a reader may see a slightly stale snapshot. Use CopyOnWriteArrayList only when reads vastly outnumber writes; otherwise prefer a synchronized list or ConcurrentHashMap-backed structure.
contentCn:
CopyOnWriteArrayList 是一种线程安全的 List 实现，其所有变更操作（add、set、remove）都会创建底层数组的一个全新副本。读取操作在当前的快照上进行，且无需任何加锁，这使得并发读取极其廉价和安全。

这种设计非常适合读多写少的场景，例如监听器列表或配置缓存，其中迭代的频率远高于修改。由于迭代器工作在创建时获取的快照上，它是 fail-safe 的，永远不会抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。

其代价在于内存和延迟：每次写入都会复制整个数组，因此写入的时间复杂度为 O(n)，在频繁更新时开销很大。此外，读取者可能会看到一个略微过期的快照。仅当读取操作远多于写入时才使用 CopyOnWriteArrayList；否则应优先选择同步列表或基于 ConcurrentHashMap 的结构。

title: BlockingQueue for Producer-Consumer
contentMd:
A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe queue that supports operations which block when the queue is empty (on take) or full (on put). It is the standard coordination primitive between producer and consumer threads and is widely used inside thread pools and task pipelines.

Java provides several implementations. ArrayBlockingQueue is a bounded queue backed by an array; LinkedBlockingQueue is optionally bounded and based on linked nodes; PriorityBlockingQueue orders elements by priority; and SynchronousQueue hands tasks directly from producer to consumer with no buffering.

In practice, choosing the right implementation matters. A bounded queue such as ArrayBlockingQueue prevents unbounded memory growth and enables sensible rejection policies in thread pools. Blocking methods like put and take simplify producer-consumer code because they handle waiting and waking for you, removing the need for manual wait/notify loops.
contentCn:
BlockingQueue 是一种线程安全的队列，支持在队列为空（take 时）或已满（put 时）时阻塞的操作。它是生产者线程与消费者线程之间标准的协调原语，被广泛应用于线程池和任务流水线中。

Java 提供了多种实现。ArrayBlockingQueue 是由数组支撑的有界队列；LinkedBlockingQueue 基于链表节点，可配置为有界或无界；PriorityBlockingQueue 按优先级对元素排序；而 SynchronousQueue 不提供缓冲，直接将任务从生产者交给消费者。

在实践中，选择合适实现很重要。像 ArrayBlockingQueue 这样的有界队列能防止内存无限制增长，并在线程池中启用合理的拒绝策略。put 和 take 等阻塞方法简化了生产者-消费者代码，因为它们替你处理了等待与唤醒，无需手动编写 wait/notify 循环。
titleCn: 用于生产者-消费者的 BlockingQueue

title: How HashMap Works Internally
contentMd:
A HashMap stores entries in an array of buckets, and the bucket index for a key is derived from the hash of its key. Java computes a secondary hash to spread keys evenly and then uses (n - 1) & hash to find the bucket, which is why the array length is always a power of two.

Each bucket holds a linked list of entries (or a balanced tree in Java 8+ when a bucket grows beyond eight entries). Collisions are resolved by chaining. The load factor, default 0.75, controls when the map resizes: when the number of entries exceeds capacity times load factor, the array is doubled and all entries are rehashed into the new buckets.

Resizing is an expensive O(n) operation, so choosing an appropriate initial capacity matters for performance-critical code. In Java 8, when a bucket becomes too large it converts to a red-black tree, improving worst-case lookup from O(n) to O(log n). Understanding these internals helps you tune capacity and avoid hash collisions in interviews.
contentCn:
HashMap 将条目存储在一个桶数组中，键所对应的桶索引由其键的哈希值推导而来。Java 会计算一个二次哈希以使键分布均匀，然后使用 (n - 1) & hash 来找到桶的位置，这也解释了为什么数组长度始终是 2 的幂。

每个桶中保存着一个条目的链表（在 Java 8+ 中，当某个桶的条目超过 8 个时会转为平衡树）。冲突通过链式法解决。负载因子（默认 0.75）控制映射何时扩容：当条目数量超过容量乘以负载因子时，数组会翻倍，并且所有条目会被重新哈希到新的桶中。

扩容是一个代价为 O(n) 的昂贵操作，因此在性能攸关的代码中，选择合适的初始容量很重要。在 Java 8 中，当某个桶过大时会转换为红黑树，从而将最坏情况下的查找复杂度从 O(n) 提升到 O(log n)。理解这些内部机制有助于你在面试中调优容量并避免哈希冲突。

title: Lambda Expressions in Java
contentMd:
A lambda expression is a concise way to represent an anonymous function, a block of code that can be passed around like data. Before Java 8, expressing behavior as a parameter meant writing a verbose anonymous inner class. With lambdas and the arrow syntax, (a, b) -> a + b reads exactly as "given a and b, return their sum" without ceremony.

Under the hood a lambda is not an anonymous class. The compiler translates it into an invokedynamic call that, on first use, creates a function object bound to a functional interface. This makes lambdas cheaper than inner classes and lets the JVM optimize them over time. The lambda can only use variables from the enclosing scope if they are effectively final, meaning they are assigned once and never changed.

In a backend interview, lambdas matter because they are the foundation of the Stream API and modern callback style. A common trap is capturing a mutable local variable or doing heavy work inside a lambda used in a parallel stream, which can serialize execution or cause data races. Used well, lambdas make code shorter and intent clearer; used carelessly, they hide side effects that are hard to debug.
contentCn:
Lambda 表达式是一种简洁地表示匿名函数的方式——也就是一段可以像数据一样被传递的代码块。在 Java 8 之前，要把行为作为参数传递，只能写一个冗长的匿名内部类。而通过使用箭头语法，lambda 让 (a, b) -> a + b 直白地表达“给定 a 和 b，返回它们的和”，没有任何多余仪式。

在底层，lambda 并不是匿名内部类。编译器会把它翻译成一次 invokedynamic 调用，在首次使用时创建一个绑定到某个函数式接口（functional interface）的函数对象。这让 lambda 比内部类更轻量，也让 JVM 能够随着时间推移对其进行优化。lambda 只能使用来自外围作用域、且“事实上不可变（effectively final）”的变量——也就是只赋值一次、此后不再修改的变量。

在后端面试中，lambda 之所以重要，是因为它是 Stream API 和现代回调风格的基石。一个常见陷阱是捕获可变局部变量，或在一个用于并行流的 lambda 中做繁重工作，这会让执行被串行化，甚至引发数据竞争。用得好，lambda 让代码更短、意图更清晰；用得随意，则会埋下难以排查的副作用。
titleCn: Java 中的 Lambda 表达式

title: The Stream API Pipeline
contentMd:
The Stream API, introduced in Java 8, lets you describe collection processing as a chain of operations rather than hand-written loops. You obtain a stream from a source, apply intermediate steps such as filter and map, and close with a terminal operation like collect, count, or reduce that actually triggers the work.

Intermediate operations are lazy: they build a description of the pipeline but do nothing until a terminal operation runs. This means an expensive map is evaluated only for elements that survive the filter, and techniques like limit or findFirst can stop processing early without touching the rest of the data.

The biggest mistake candidates make is reusing a stream, which is single-use and throws IllegalStateException on a second terminal call. Another is mutating the source collection while streaming. A well-formed pipeline keeps each step pure and stateless, which makes it both easier to test and safe to reason about whether it runs sequentially or in parallel.
contentCn:
Java 8 引入的 Stream API，让你用一连串操作来描述集合处理，而不必手写循环。你从一个数据源拿到流，施加 filter、map 这样的中间步骤，最后用 collect、count 或 reduce 这样的终端操作收尾，真正的工作就是由这个终端操作触发的。

中间操作是惰性的：它们只构建出流水线的“描述”，在终端操作运行之前什么都不做。这意味着昂贵的 map 只会对通过 filter 的元素求值，而 limit、findFirst 这类技巧还能提前结束，根本不去处理剩余数据。

面试者最常犯的错误是重复使用同一个流——流是一次性的，第二次调用终端操作会抛出 IllegalStateException。另一个错误是在流式处理过程中修改源集合。一条良好的流水线会让每一步都保持纯粹、无状态，这样无论顺序执行还是并行执行，它都既易于测试又便于推理。

title: Avoiding Null with Optional
contentMd:
Optional is a container object introduced in Java 8 to make the absence of a value explicit. Instead of returning null and hoping the caller remembers to check, a method can return Optional<User>, signaling that a result may be missing. This shifts a common runtime bug into a compile-time conversation.

The value of Optional is the fluent API it provides: orElse supplies a default, orElseGet computes one lazily, ifPresent runs code only when a value exists, and flatMap chains further optional-returning calls without nested null checks. Used in a return position, it documents intent and guides the caller toward safe handling.

The pitfall is treating Optional as a cure-all. It should not be used for fields, method parameters, or collection elements, where a normal null check or empty collection is clearer and cheaper. Calling get() without isPresent() defeats the purpose and can throw NoSuchElementException. Reach for Optional to represent an optional return value, not to wrap every nullable reference in your codebase.
contentCn:
Optional 是 Java 8 引入的容器对象，用来把“值缺失”这件事显式表达出来。比起返回 null 并指望调用方记得做判空，一个方法可以返回 Optional<User>，明确告诉调用方结果可能不存在。这把一个常见的运行时 bug 提前成了编译期就应当讨论的问题。

Optional 的价值在于它提供的流式 API：orElse 给出一个默认值，orElseGet 惰性计算一个默认值，ifPresent 只在值存在时才执行代码，而 flatMap 能链式串联更多返回 Optional 的调用，无需层层嵌套的判空。用在返回值位置上，它既记录了意图，也引导调用方安全地处理结果。

它的陷阱在于被当成万能药。Optional 不该用于字段、方法参数或集合元素——在这些地方，一次普通的判空或返回一个空集合反而更清晰、更廉价。在没有 isPresent() 的情况下调用 get()，会违背初衷并可能抛出 NoSuchElementException。请把 Optional 用来表示“可选的返回值”，而不是把它套进代码里每一个可空引用。
titleCn: 用 Optional 规避空指针

title: Default Methods in Interfaces
contentMd:
Java 8 allowed interfaces to carry default methods, declared with the default keyword and providing a concrete implementation. This was primarily a pragmatic move so that the Collection interface could gain stream() and forEach() without forcing every existing implementation to be rewritten.

Default methods enable a limited form of multiple inheritance of behavior. When a class implements two interfaces that both define the same default method, the compiler refuses to pick a winner and requires the class to override the method explicitly, often with InterfaceA.super.method() to choose one. This resolves ambiguity at the source rather than by hidden rules.

They are not a replacement for abstract classes, because an interface still cannot hold state and a default method can only call other interface methods. A sound use is providing stable convenience behavior on top of a few abstract methods, as List does with replaceAll. Overusing them to share logic tends to muddy the contract that an interface is supposed to represent.
contentCn:
Java 8 允许接口携带默认方法（default method），用 default 关键字声明并给出具体实现。这主要是一项务实之举：让 Collection 接口得以新增 stream() 和 forEach() 等方法，却不必强迫每一个既有的实现类都重写一遍。

默认方法带来了一种受限的“行为多重继承”。当一个类同时实现了两个接口，而这两个接口都定义了同一个默认方法时，编译器不会擅自替你做选择，而是要求该类显式重写该方法，通常借助 InterfaceA.super.method() 来明确选定其一。这样，歧义被消解在了源码层面，而不是靠隐晦的规则。

默认方法并不能取代抽象类，因为接口依然不能持有状态，默认方法也只能源调用接口上的其他方法。一个恰当用法是：在少数抽象方法之上提供稳定的便捷行为，正如 List 用 replaceAll 做的那样。若把它们过度用于共享逻辑，往往会模糊接口本该表达的契约。

title: The Modern Date and Time API
contentMd:
The java.time package, added in Java 8, replaced the error-prone java.util.Date and Calendar. The old classes were mutable, had a zero-based month, and stored years as offsets from 1900, all of which caused countless off-by-one bugs. The new API is built around immutable, clearly named classes such as LocalDate, LocalTime, LocalDateTime, and ZonedDateTime.

Each type models exactly what its name says. LocalDate holds a date with no time or zone, ideal for birthdays and deadlines. ZonedDateTime adds the zone rules needed for correct scheduling across regions. Because the objects are immutable, operations like plusDays return a new instance instead of changing the old one, which makes date math thread-safe by construction.

Time zones and daylight saving are where the old API failed most often. With java.time you separate the instant on the timeline, represented by Instant, from the human-facing local view, and conversion is explicit and checked. In an interview, being able to contrast the immutability and clarity of java.time with the mutable legacy classes shows you understand why the redesign was necessary.
contentCn:
Java 8 新增的 java.time 包，取代了问题多多的 java.util.Date 和 Calendar。旧类是可变的，月份从 0 开始计数，年份还要以 1900 为基准做偏移，这些都制造了数不清的“差一”类 bug。新 API 建立在一组不可变、命名清晰的类型之上，例如 LocalDate、LocalTime、LocalDateTime 与 ZonedDateTime。

每个类型都精确对应它的名字所表达的含义。LocalDate 只持有日期、不含时间与时区，非常适合生日和截止日期这类场景。ZonedDateTime 则附加了跨地区排程所需的时区规则。因为这些对象不可变，像 plusDays 这样的操作会返回一个新实例，而非修改旧对象，这使得日期运算天生就是线程安全的。

时区与夏令时正是旧 API 最常翻车的地方。在 java.time 中，你用 Instant 表示时间线上的那个“时刻”，用面向人的本地视图表示本地时间，二者分离，并且转换是显式且经过校验的。面试时，能拿 java.time 的不可变与清晰去对比可变的旧类，就说明你理解了这次重新设计的必要性。
titleEn: The Modern Date and Time API

title: Method References
contentMd:
A method reference is shorthand for a lambda that simply forwards its arguments to an existing method. Where you might write s -> System.out.println(s), the form System.out::println expresses the same behavior with less noise, and the compiler infers the parameter types for you.

There are four common shapes. A static reference like Integer::parseInt maps a class method to a function, an instance-on-receiver form like String::length calls a method on the argument, an instance-on-supplied-object form like obj::doWork binds to a specific instance, and a constructor reference like ArrayList::new acts as a factory.

Method references improve readability when the lambda body is a single delegated call, but they are not always clearer. If the logic involves more than passing arguments through, an explicit lambda keeps intent obvious. In interviews, candidates who reach for method references appropriately signal fluency with the functional style rather than merely knowing it exists.
contentCn:
方法引用（method reference）是 lambda 的一种简写：当 lambda 只是把自己的参数转交给某个既有方法时，就可以用它。你本来可以写作 s -> System.out.println(s)，而用 System.out::println 就能以更少的噪声表达相同行为，参数类型还由编译器替你推断。

它有四种常见形态。像 Integer::parseInt 这样的静态引用把类方法映射成函数；String::length 这种“接收者上调用”形式对参数调用其方法；obj::doWork 这种“绑定到特定实例”形式绑定到某个具体对象；而 ArrayList::new 这样的构造器引用则充当工厂。

当 lambda 主体只是一次单纯的委派调用时，方法引用能提升可读性，但它并不总是更清晰。如果逻辑不只是“透传参数”，那么显式写出 lambda 反而能让意图更明显。面试中，那些恰当地选用方法引用的人，传递出的是对函数式风格的熟练运用，而不只是“知道有这东西”。

title: Local Variable Type Inference with var
contentMd:
Java 10 introduced var, which lets the compiler infer the type of a local variable from its initializer. Writing var users = new ArrayList<User>() keeps the concrete type obvious from the right-hand side while sparing you from repeating a long generic signature.

It is important to understand what var is not. It is not a dynamic or weakly typed feature; the variable still has a precise static type checked at compile time, and the bytecode is identical to writing the type explicitly. var can only be used for locals with an initializer, not for fields, method parameters, or return types.

Used sparingly, var reduces noise in dense data-processing code. Used everywhere, it hides the type and hurts readability when the initializer does not make it clear. A good rule is to use var when the type is obvious from the expression, and spell out the type when inference would leave a reader guessing.
contentCn:
Java 10 引入了 var，让编译器能根据局部变量的初始化表达式推断其类型。写成 var users = new ArrayList<User>()，右边已经清楚地给出了具体类型，你就不必再重复一遍冗长的泛型签名。

理解 var 的“边界”很重要。它并非动态类型或弱类型特性——变量依然拥有一个精确的、在编译期就被检查出来的静态类型，生成的字节码也与显式写出类型完全一致。var 只能用于带有初始化表达式的局部变量，不能用于字段、方法参数或返回值。

适度使用 var，能减少密集数据处理代码中的噪声；处处都用，则会在初始化表达式看不出类型时掩盖信息、损害可读性。一个好的准则是：当类型从表达式中一眼可见时用 var，当推断会让读者犯嘀咕时，就把类型明明白白写出来。
titleEn: Local Variable Type Inference with var
titleCn: 用 var 做局部变量类型推断

title: Records for Immutable Data
contentMd:
Java 16 finalized records, a concise declaration for classes whose main job is to carry immutable data. Writing record Point(int x, int y) generates the fields, a canonical constructor, accessors, equals, hashCode, and toString, all of which previously demanded a page of boilerplate.

A record is immutable: the component fields are final and any method you add must not mutate them. You can customize behavior by declaring your own constructor, adding static factory methods, or implementing interfaces, but you cannot extend another class because records already inherit from Record.

In backend code, records are ideal for DTOs, API responses, and value objects that group a few related fields. They make illegal states unrepresentable and compare by value rather than identity, which fits the functional, data-oriented style encouraged by the Stream API. The trade-off is that a record is a poor fit for entities that need mutable state and lifecycle behavior.
contentCn:
Java 16 正式确定了 record（记录），它是对“以承载不可变数据为主要职责”的类的一种简洁声明。写下一行 record Point(int x, int y)，编译器就会生成字段、规范构造器、访问器、equals、hashCode 和 toString——而这些在过去需要满满一页样板代码。

record 是不可变的：组件字段是 final 的，你添加的任何方法都不得修改它们。你可以通过声明自己的构造器、添加静态工厂方法或实现接口来定制行为，但你不能再去继承别的类，因为 record 已经继承自 Record。

在后端代码中，record 非常适合 DTO、API 响应，以及把若干相关字段聚合起来的值对象（value object）。它让不合法的状态无法被表示出来，并且按值而非按身份进行比较，这正契合 Stream API 所倡导的函数式、面向数据的风格。代价在于：对于需要可变状态和生命周期行为的实体，record 并不合适。
titleCn: 用于不可变数据的 Record

title: Sealed Classes and Exhaustive Hierarchies
contentMd:
Sealed classes, finalized in Java 17, let a type restrict which other classes or interfaces may extend or implement it. By marking a superclass sealed and listing its permitted subclasses, you make the set of subtypes known to the compiler and closed to surprise additions.

This enables exhaustive checking in switch expressions. When the selector is a sealed type and the cases cover every permitted subtype, the compiler knows no other possibility exists and does not require a default branch. That turns a class hierarchy into a compile-time guarantee, so adding a new subtype forces you to handle it everywhere it matters.

Sealed types pair naturally with records to model algebraic data. A command hierarchy where every command is a record and the root is sealed gives you precise, self-documenting domain models. The balance is intentionality: sealing is most valuable when the set of variants is genuinely fixed, such as protocol messages or state machines, and less so when you expect third parties to extend your types.
contentCn:
Java 17 正式引入的密封类（sealed class），让一个类型能够限制到底有哪些类或接口可以继承或实现它。把父类标记为 sealed 并列出其允许的子类后，子类型的集合就对编译器已知、且不会再被意外扩展。

这让 switch 表达式能够进行穷尽式检查。当选择器是密封类型、且分支覆盖了每一个允许的子类时，编译器知道不存在其他可能，因而不再需要一个 default 分支。这等于把一个类层级变成了编译期保证：一旦新增一个子类型，编译器会强制你在所有相关的地方都处理它。

密封类型与 record 天然契合，可用来建模代数数据类型。比如一个命令层级：每个命令都是 record，根类型是 sealed，由此得到的领域模型既精确又自文档化。这里的关键在于“有意为之”：只有当变体集合确实固定时（例如协议消息或状态机），密封才最有价值；若你期望第三方来扩展你的类型，它就不太合适了。

title: Functional Interfaces and the Type System
contentMd:
A functional interface is an interface with exactly one abstract method, often annotated @FunctionalInterface to ask the compiler to enforce that constraint. This single-method shape is what lets a lambda or method reference be assigned to it, because the compiler knows precisely which method the behavior must implement.

Java ships a useful family in java.util.function: Predicate tests a condition, Function transforms input to output, Consumer acts on input without returning, Supplier provides a value, and the primitive-specialized variants like IntFunction avoid boxing. Defining your own named functional interface is worthwhile when a generic one would make call sites unclear.

In interviews, candidates sometimes confuse functional interfaces with lambdas. The lambda is the value, the functional interface is the type it conforms to. Understanding this distinction explains why you cannot assign a lambda to an interface with two abstract methods, and why method overloading that differs only by functional interface parameter types can become ambiguous at the call site.
contentCn:
函数式接口（functional interface）是只含一个抽象方法的接口，通常加上 @FunctionalInterface 注解，请编译器强制这一约束。正是这种“单方法”形态，使得 lambda 或方法引用能够被赋值给它——因为编译器确切知道这段行为要实现的是哪一个方法。

Java 在 java.util.function 中提供了一组实用家族：Predicate 判断条件，Function 把输入变换为输出，Consumer 消费输入但不返回，Supplier 提供一个值，而像 IntFunction 这样的原始类型特化变体则避免了装箱。当某个通用接口会让调用处含义模糊时，定义你自己的具名函数式接口是值得的。

面试中，有人会把函数式接口和 lambda 混为一谈。lambda 是“值”，函数式接口是它所遵从的“类型”。理解这一区别，就能解释为何不能把 lambda 赋给带有多个抽象方法的接口，以及为何仅靠函数式接口参数类型来区分的方法重载，在调用处可能变得含糊不清。
titleEn: Functional Interfaces and the Type System
titleCn: 函数式接口与类型系统

title: Effectively Final Variables
contentMd:
A variable is effectively final when it is assigned exactly once and never reassigned afterward, even though you did not write the final keyword. Lambda expressions and anonymous classes may only reference such variables from their enclosing scope, which is why a counter incremented in a loop cannot be captured by a lambda.

The restriction exists because lambdas can outlive the method frame that created them. If a captured local could change after capture, different threads or later invocations would observe inconsistent values, reintroducing the very concurrency bugs that the functional style tries to avoid. Treating captured variables as frozen keeps the model simple and safe.

When you genuinely need mutable state shared with a lambda, reach for an explicit container such as an array of one element or an AtomicInteger, or better, restructure so the value flows through the stream as data. An interviewer who asks about this is probing whether you understand closure capture and the difference between final and effectively final.
contentCn:
所谓“事实上的不可变（effectively final）”变量，是指虽然你没有写 final 关键字，但它只被赋值一次、此后便不再被重新赋值。Lambda 表达式和匿名类只能引用外围作用域中这类变量，这也解释了为什么循环里被不断自增的计数器无法被 lambda 捕获。

这条限制存在，是因为 lambda 的寿命可能长于创建它的那个方法栈帧。如果被捕获的局部变量在捕获之后还能改变，不同的线程或后续的调用就会观察到不一致的值，从而重新引入函数式风格本想规避的那类并发 bug。把被捕获的变量视作“冻结”，能让整个模型既简单又安全。

当你确实需要与 lambda 共享可变状态时，应改用显式的容器，例如一个长度为 1 的数组或 AtomicInteger；更好的做法则是重构，让这个值作为数据在流中流动。面试官问到这一点，其实是在考察你是否理解闭包捕获，以及 final 与 effectively final 之间的区别。

title: Parallel Streams and Their Costs
contentMd:
A sequential stream becomes parallel with a single parallel() call, after which the fork join pool splits the data into chunks and processes them on worker threads. For large, independent, CPU-bound workloads this can use all available cores and cut wall-clock time substantially.

The benefits are not free. Splitting, scheduling, and merging carry overhead, so small or quickly processed datasets often run slower in parallel. Worse, parallel streams share the common ForkJoinPool, so a slow or blocking operation in one place can starve unrelated parallel tasks across the whole application.

Correctness is the harder part. Parallel pipelines must be stateless and non-interfering; any shared mutable state, such as appending to a list during forEach, produces races. In an interview, the mature answer is not "parallel is faster" but "measure first, keep operations pure, and prefer explicit executors when you need isolation or control over the thread pool."
contentCn:
只要调用一次 parallel()，顺序流就会变成并行流，随后 fork join 池会把数据切分成多个分块，放在工作线程上处理。对于大型、相互独立、受 CPU 限制的负载，它能用满所有核心，显著缩短墙钟时间（wall-clock time）。
