但收益并非免费。切分、调度与合并都有开销，所以数据量小或处理很快的数据集，并行反而常常更慢。更糟的是，并行流共享同一个公共 ForkJoinPool——某一处出现缓慢或阻塞的操作，就可能拖垮整个应用中其他毫不相关的并行任务。

更难的是正确性。并行流水线必须是无状态、互不干扰的；任何共享可变状态（比如在 forEach 中往一个列表里追加元素）都会引发竞争。面试中成熟的回答不是“并行更快”，而是“先测量，保持操作纯粹，并且当你需要隔离或对线程池加以控制时，优先使用显式的 executor”。

title: Grouping and Reducing with Collectors
contentMd:
The terminal operation collect turns a stream back into a concrete structure, and the Collectors factory provides the building blocks. The most common is toList or toMap, but groupingBy is where interviews get interesting, because it performs a map-reduce in a single pass over the data.

groupingBy(classifier) partitions elements by a key, while groupingBy(classifier, downstream) lets you summarize each group, for example counting members, averaging a field, or collecting them into a list. downstream collectors compose, so you can group orders by region and then find the highest-value order in each region without writing nested loops.

A frequent pitfall is toMap colliding on duplicate keys, which throws IllegalStateException unless you supply a merge function. Another is using collect when a simpler terminal such as count or max would do. Knowing when a collector is the right tool, and how downstream collectors nest, separates candidates who merely use streams from those who think in terms of aggregation.
contentCn:
终端操作 collect 把流重新变回一个具体结构，而 Collectors 工厂提供了所需的基础构件。最常用的是 toList 或 toMap，但 groupingBy 才是面试中最有意思的地方——它能在一遍遍历中完成一次 map-reduce。

groupingBy(classifier) 按某个键对元素做分区；而 groupingBy(classifier, downstream) 让你对每个分组做汇总，例如统计成员数、对某个字段求平均，或把它们收集成一个列表。下游收集器可以组合嵌套，于是你能在一次操作中按地区对订单分组，再找出每个地区里价值最高的那笔订单，无需写嵌套循环。

一个常见陷阱是 toMap 在遇到重复键时会抛出 IllegalStateException，除非你提供一个合并函数。另一个是用 collect 去做那些 count 或 max 等更简单的终端操作就能完成的活。知道何时该用收集器、以及下游收集器如何嵌套，正是“只是用用流”和“以聚合思维思考”的面试者之间的分水岭。
titleCn: 用 Collector 做分组与归约

title: Pattern Matching for switch
contentMd:
Pattern matching for switch, standardized in Java 21, lets a case test the type of the selector and bind it to a variable in one step. Instead of a chain of instanceof checks followed by casts, you write case String s -> s.length(), and the compiler proves the cast is safe and the binding is in scope.

Guarded patterns extend this with a when clause, so case Integer i when i > 0 lets you split behavior within a type without nesting if statements. Combined with sealed types, a switch over a known hierarchy can be exhaustively checked, removing the need for a default that merely throws an error.

The advantage over the classic switch is expressiveness and safety. You no longer repeat the variable name or perform manual casts, and the compiler catches missing cases for sealed types. Candidates who adopt pattern matching show they value code that states intent directly and leans on the compiler to enforce completeness.
contentCn:
Java 21 标准化了的 switch 模式匹配，让 case 能够一步完成“判断选择器类型”与“把结果绑定到变量”。你不再需要先写一串 instanceof 判断再做强制转换，而是直接写 case String s -> s.length()，编译器会证明该转换安全，且绑定变量在作用域内可用。

带守卫（guard）的模式进一步引入 when 子句，于是 case Integer i when i > 0 让你在同一类型内部按条件拆分行为，而不必嵌套 if 语句。再结合密封类型，对一个已知层级的 switch 就能做穷尽检查，从而不再需要一个“只会抛错”的 default 分支。

相较于经典 switch，它的优势在于表达力与安全性。你不必重复变量名，也不用手写强制转换，编译器还会针对密封类型捕获遗漏的分支。那些采用模式匹配的面试者，展现出的是对“让代码直陈意图、并借助编译器强制完整性”的看重。

title: Text Blocks for Multiline Strings
contentMd:
Java 15 finalized text blocks, delimited by triple quotes, to hold multiline string literals without concatenating plus signs or escaping newlines. A SQL query, a JSON payload, or an HTML fragment can now be written almost exactly as it appears in the editor.

The compiler applies incidental whitespace stripping so the block is not distorted by the indentation needed to keep your code tidy. You can still embed values with String.format or the formatted method, and a \ at the end of a line suppresses the line break when you need precise control.

Text blocks are a readability win for any backend code that embeds structured text, especially in tests and data-access layers. The caution is that they are still ordinary String objects, so concatenation inside a loop remains a performance concern and should use a builder. Know that they simplify literals, not heavy string assembly.
contentCn:
Java 15 正式确定了文本块（text block），用三重引号界定，用来承载多行字符串字面量，无需再用加号拼接或转义换行符。一条 SQL 查询、一段 JSON 负载，或一个 HTML 片段，如今几乎可以按照它在编辑器里的样子原样写下来。

编译器会执行“附带空白剥离（incidental whitespace stripping）”，因此代码为保持整齐所需的缩进不会扭曲文本内容。你依然可以用 String.format 或 formatted 方法嵌入变量；而在行末加一个反斜杠 \，则能在你需要精确控制时抑制换行。

对于任何会在内嵌结构化文本的 Java 后端代码，文本块都是可读性的胜利，在测试层和数据库访问层尤其明显。需要警惕的是：它们本质上仍是普通的 String 对象，因此在循环里拼接字符串依旧是性能隐患，应当使用 builder。要明白文本块简化的是字面量，而非繁重的字符串组装。
titleCn: 用于多行字符串的文本块

title: IoC and DI in Spring
contentMd:
Q: What are Inversion of Control (IoC) and Dependency Injection (DI) in Spring, and how do they relate?

Inversion of Control is a design principle in which the framework, rather than the application code, takes control of object creation and wiring. In traditional code you instantiate collaborators yourself with `new`; under IoC the container owns this responsibility, so control is inverted. Spring's implementation of IoC is the ApplicationContext, which manages a graph of objects called beans.

Dependency Injection is the mechanism Spring uses to achieve IoC. Instead of a class looking up or constructing its dependencies, they are provided to it from the outside—typically through constructor arguments, setter methods, or fields annotated with `@Autowired`. The class therefore declares what it needs and remains unaware of how those dependencies are created or configured.

Constructor injection is generally preferred because it guarantees required dependencies are available at construction time, supports immutability, and makes the class easy to test. Field injection is convenient but hides dependencies and complicates unit testing, while setter injection suits optional or reconfigurable dependencies.

In interviews, emphasize that IoC is the broader concept and DI is the concrete technique. Spring's DI reduces coupling, improves testability, and centralizes configuration, which is why these ideas are foundational to the framework.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中的控制反转（IoC）与依赖注入（DI）是什么，二者有何关系？

控制反转是一种设计原则，由框架而非应用代码来负责对象的创建与装配。在传统的代码中，你通过 `new` 亲自实例化协作者；而在 IoC 下，容器接管了这一职责，因此控制被反转了。Spring 对 IoC 的实现是 ApplicationContext，它管理着一张称为 bean 的对象图。

依赖注入是 Spring 用来实现 IoC 的机制。类不再自己查找或构造依赖，而是由外部把依赖提供进来——通常通过构造器参数、setter 方法，或标注了 `@Autowired` 的字段。因此，类只需声明自己需要什么，而无需关心这些依赖是如何被创建或配置的。

构造器注入通常最受推荐，因为它能保证在构造时就具备所需的依赖、支持不可变性，并且让类易于测试。字段注入虽然方便，但会隐藏依赖并给单元测试带来困难；而 setter 注入适合可选或可重新配置的依赖。

在面试中，要强调 IoC 是更宽泛的概念，而 DI 是实现它的具体技术。Spring 的 DI 降低了耦合度、提升了可测试性，并集中了配置，这正是这些理念成为框架基石的原因。
titleCn: Spring 中的 IoC 与 DI

title: The Spring Bean Lifecycle
contentMd:
Q: Walk me through the Spring bean lifecycle from instantiation to destruction.

The lifecycle begins when the container reads your configuration and decides which beans to create. For each bean, Spring first instantiates the object—usually by calling its constructor through reflection. At this point the object exists but its dependencies are not yet assigned.

Next comes population of properties, also known as dependency injection, where the container injects the bean's collaborators. After that, Spring invokes any `BeanNameAware`, `BeanFactoryAware`, and similar aware interfaces so the bean can learn about its environment.

The most important hooks are the `BeanPostProcessor` callbacks: `postProcessBeforeInitialization` and `postProcessAfterInitialization` run around the initialization method. If the bean implements `InitializingBean` or declares an init method, that runs during initialization, where you can perform setup such as opening resources.

Finally, when the container shuts down, beans that implement `DisposableBean` or declare a destroy method run their cleanup logic, releasing connections or threads. Understanding this order helps you place custom logic at the right stage and debug issues like beans created twice or proxies not applied.
contentCn:
问题：请描述 Spring bean 从实例化到销毁的完整生命周期。

生命周期始于容器读取你的配置并决定要创建哪些 bean。对于每个 bean，Spring 首先进行实例化——通常是通过反射调用其构造器。此时对象已经存在，但它的依赖尚未被赋值。

接下来是属性填充（即依赖注入），容器在此将协作对象注入进来。之后，Spring 会调用 `BeanNameAware`、`BeanFactoryAware` 等 aware 接口，让 bean 了解它所处的环境。

最重要的钩子是 `BeanPostProcessor` 回调：`postProcessBeforeInitialization` 与 `postProcessAfterInitialization` 会围绕初始化方法执行。如果 bean 实现了 `InitializingBean` 或声明了 init 方法，初始化阶段就会运行它，你可以在其中执行诸如打开资源之类的初始化工作。

最后，当容器关闭时，实现了 `DisposableBean` 或声明了 destroy 方法的 bean 会运行其清理逻辑，释放连接或线程。理解这一顺序有助于你把自定义逻辑放在正确的阶段，并排查诸如 bean 被创建两次或代理未生效之类的问题。

title: Spring Bean Scopes
contentMd:
Q: What bean scopes does Spring support, and when would you use each?

A scope defines the lifecycle and visibility of a bean within the container. The default and most common scope is `singleton`, meaning Spring creates exactly one shared instance per container and returns it for every request. Singletons are stateless and thread-safe by design, which suits most service and repository classes.

`prototype` creates a new instance every time the bean is requested. This is appropriate for stateful objects where each consumer needs its own copy, such as a command or a batch-processing context. Be aware that Spring does not manage the full lifecycle of prototypes—destruction callbacks are not called.

Web-aware scopes include `request`, `session`, and `application`. A `request` bean lives for a single HTTP request, a `session` bean for a user session, and an `application` bean for the lifecycle of the ServletContext. These are only available in a web-aware ApplicationContext.

A classic interview trap is injecting a `prototype` bean into a `singleton`: because the singleton is created once, it receives the prototype instance only once, so you do not get a fresh prototype per call. To get a new instance each time you must use `ObjectProvider` or a lookup method.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 支持哪些 bean 作用域，分别在什么场景下使用？

作用域定义了 bean 在容器中的生命周期与可见性。默认且最常见的是 `singleton`，即 Spring 为每个容器只创建一个共享实例，并在每次请求时返回它。单例在设计上是无状态且线程安全的，适用于大多数 service 和 repository 类。

`prototype` 在每次请求 bean 时都会创建一个新实例。它适合有状态对象，即每个使用者都需要自己的副本，例如命令对象或批处理上下文。注意 Spring 不会管理 prototype 的完整生命周期——其销毁回调不会被调用。

Web 相关作用域包括 `request`、`session` 和 `application`。`request` bean 存活于一次 HTTP 请求，`session` bean 存活于一个用户会话，`application` bean 存活于整个 ServletContext 的生命周期。这些作用域仅在 Web 感知的 ApplicationContext 中可用。

面试中经典的陷阱是把 `prototype` bean 注入到 `singleton` 中：由于单例只创建一次，它只会获取一次 prototype 实例，因此并不会每次调用都得到一个新的 prototype。要每次都拿到新实例，必须使用 `ObjectProvider` 或 lookup method。

title: AOP and Proxying in Spring
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring AOP work, and what role do proxies play?

Spring AOP applies cross-cutting concerns such as logging, security, and transactions by wrapping beans in proxies. When you annotate a method with `@Transactional` or define an aspect, Spring does not modify your class bytecode directly; instead it creates a proxy object that delegates to your real bean while adding the extra behavior around the call.

By default Spring uses JDK dynamic proxies when the target implements at least one interface, and CGLIB subclass proxies otherwise. The proxy intercepts method calls, runs any matching advice, and then forwards the call to the actual method. Because the advice only runs through the proxy, calls made from within the same object bypass it.

This has a famous consequence: internal self-invocation—calling a proxied method from another method of the same bean—does not trigger the advice. The call never goes through the proxy, so transaction or security logic is silently skipped, a frequent source of bugs.

In interviews, explain that AOP is proxy-based and limited to method interception on Spring-managed beans. For richer pointcuts you can mention AspectJ, which weaves at compile or load time and can advise non-Spring objects and field access.
contentCn:
问题：Spring AOP 是如何工作的，代理在其中扮演什么角色？

Spring AOP 通过把 bean 包装进代理来应用日志、安全、事务等横切关注点。当你用 `@Transactional` 标注方法或定义一个切面时，Spring 并不会直接修改你的类字节码，而是创建一个代理对象，它在调用真实 bean 的同时在调用前后附加额外行为。

默认情况下，当目标至少实现一个接口时，Spring 使用 JDK 动态代理；否则使用 CGLIB 子类代理。代理拦截方法调用，运行所有匹配的增强（advice），然后再把调用转发给真实方法。由于增强只在经过代理时才会执行，来自同一对象内部的调用会绕过它。

这带来了一个著名后果：内部自调用——即从同一个 bean 的另一个方法调用被代理的方法——不会触发增强。该调用从未经过代理，于是事务或安全逻辑被静默跳过，这是常见的 bug 来源。

在面试中，要说明 AOP 是基于代理的，且仅限于对 Spring 管理的 bean 进行方法拦截。若需要更丰富的切点，可以提及 AspectJ，它在编译期或类加载期进行织入，能够对非 Spring 对象以及字段访问进行增强。
titleCn: Spring 中的 AOP 与代理机制

title: @Transactional Propagation
contentMd:
Q: How does transaction propagation work in Spring's @Transactional?

Propagation determines what happens to the transaction context when a transactional method calls another transactional method. `REQUIRED`, the default, joins an existing transaction if one is present, otherwise starts a new one. This covers the vast majority of business cases.

`REQUIRES_NEW` always suspends any current transaction and starts a completely independent one. If the inner method fails, it rolls back its own transaction while the outer one may still commit. This is useful when you must record an audit log that survives even if the main operation fails.

`NESTED` uses a savepoint within the existing transaction, so the inner part can roll back to that point without aborting the outer transaction, though it relies on JDBC savepoints and a single physical connection. `SUPPORTS`, `NOT_SUPPORTED`, and `NEVER` control whether a transaction should be used at all, and `MANDATORY` requires one to already exist.

A key subtlety is that propagation only takes effect when the call goes through the proxy. Self-invocation from within the same bean bypasses the proxy, so changing the propagation on an internal method has no effect. Also note that runtime exceptions trigger rollback by default, while checked exceptions do not unless configured.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 的 @Transactional 中事务传播是如何工作的？

传播行为决定了当一个事务方法调用另一个事务方法时，事务上下文会发生什么。`REQUIRED` 是默认值：如果已存在事务就加入其中，否则开启一个新事务。它覆盖了绝大多数业务场景。

`REQUIRES_NEW` 总是挂起当前事务，并开启一个完全独立的新事务。如果内部方法失败，它只回滚自己的事务，而外部事务仍可能提交。当你需要记录一条即使主操作失败也要保留的审计日志时，这一行为非常有用。

`NESTED` 在现有事务中使用一个保存点，这样内部部分可以回滚到该保存点而不中止外部事务，不过它依赖于 JDBC 的 savepoint 以及单一的物理连接。`SUPPORTS`、`NOT_SUPPORTED`、`NEVER` 控制是否应当使用事务，`MANDATORY` 则要求必须已存在事务。

一个关键细节是：传播行为只有在调用经过代理时才会生效。同一个 bean 内部的自调用会绕过代理，因此修改内部方法的传播设置毫无效果。还要注意：默认情况下运行时异常会触发回滚，而受检异常不会，除非显式配置。

title: Circular Dependencies in Spring
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring handle circular dependencies between beans?

A circular dependency occurs when bean A needs bean B, and B in turn needs A. With constructor injection, Spring cannot resolve this at all and throws a `BeanCurrentlyInCreationException` at startup, because it cannot instantiate either bean before the other is ready.

With setter or field injection, Spring solves it using a three-level cache and a technique called 'early reference'. When A is being created, its raw (uninitialized) instance is exposed early in a cache. When B needs A, it receives this early reference, allowing B to finish, after which A can be injected with the completed B.

It is important to understand this works for singleton beans only. Prototype beans cannot be resolved circularly because Spring does not cache them; it will fail with an error. Also, the early-reference mechanism cannot always produce a fully initialized object, which is why constructor injection is considered safer.

In modern Spring, the cleanest fix is to redesign so the dependency cycle is removed, often by extracting shared logic into a third bean. From Spring 2.6, circular references are detected and reported earlier, and you can forbid them entirely with `spring.main.allow-circular-references=false`.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 是如何处理 bean 之间的循环依赖的？

当两个 bean 互相依赖时，就会出现循环依赖，例如 bean A 需要 B，而 B 又需要 A。使用构造器注入时，Spring 根本无法解决这种循环，会在启动时抛出 `BeanCurrentlyInCreationException`，因为它无法在另一个 bean 就绪之前实例化其中任何一个。

使用 setter 或字段注入时，Spring 借助三级缓存和一种称为“提前暴露引用”的技术来解决。当 A 正在创建时，它的原始（未初始化）实例会被提前放入缓存。当 B 需要 A 时，它拿到这个早期引用，使 B 得以完成；随后 A 就能被注入已完工的 B。

需要理解的是，这仅对单例 bean 有效。prototype bean 无法被循环解析，因为 Spring 不会缓存它们，最终会报错。此外，提前引用机制未必总能产出完全初始化的对象，这也正是构造器注入被认为更安全的原因。

在现代 Spring 中，最干净的修复方式是重新设计以消除依赖环，通常是把共享逻辑抽取到第三个 bean 中。从 Spring 2.6 起，循环引用会被更早地检测并报告，你也可以通过 `spring.main.allow-circular-references=false` 完全禁止它们。

title: The Spring MVC Request Flow
contentMd:
Q: Trace a request through the Spring MVC framework.

When an HTTP request arrives, the `DispatcherServlet`—the front controller—receives it first. It consults the `HandlerMapping` to find the controller method whose `@RequestMapping` matches the request URL and HTTP method, producing a `HandlerExecutionChain` that also includes any interceptors.

The `HandlerAdapter` then invokes the chosen handler method, resolving method arguments through `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` (for `@PathVariable`, `@RequestBody`, etc.) and converting the return value. Before and after the call, `HandlerInterceptor` methods such as `preHandle` and `postHandle` run, letting you implement cross-cutting logic like authentication and logging.

The handler's return value—often a `ModelAndView` or a `@ResponseBody` object—is passed to the `ViewResolver` if a view is needed, or serialized to JSON by a `HttpMessageConverter` when the method is annotated with `@ResponseBody` or `@RestController`.

Finally, the `DispatcherServlet` renders the view or writes the response and runs `afterCompletion` on interceptors. Knowing this pipeline helps you place filters, interceptors, and exception handlers at the correct layer and debug issues like a 404 from a missing mapping or a 400 from bad argument binding.
contentCn:
问题：请描述一个请求在 Spring MVC 框架中的处理过程。

当 HTTP 请求到达时，作为前端控制器的 `DispatcherServlet` 首先接收它。它会查询 `HandlerMapping`，找到 `@RequestMapping` 与请求 URL 及 HTTP 方法相匹配的控制器方法，并生成一个 `HandlerExecutionChain`，其中也包含相关的拦截器。

接着，`HandlerAdapter` 调用被选中的处理器方法，通过 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver`（用于处理 `@PathVariable`、`@RequestBody` 等）解析方法参数并转换返回值。在调用前后，`HandlerInterceptor` 的 `preHandle`、`postHandle` 等方法会运行，让你能够实现认证、日志等横切逻辑。

处理器方法的返回值——通常是一个 `ModelAndView` 或标注了 `@ResponseBody` 的对象——如果需要视图，则交给 `ViewResolver`；当方法标注了 `@ResponseBody` 或所在类为 `@RestController` 时，则由 `HttpMessageConverter` 序列化为 JSON。

最后，`DispatcherServlet` 渲染视图或写出响应，并对拦截器执行 `afterCompletion`。了解这条处理管道，有助于你把过滤器、拦截器和异常处理器放在正确的层级，并能排查诸如因映射缺失导致的 404、因参数绑定失败导致的 400 等问题。
titleCn: Spring MVC 的请求处理流程

title: BeanPostProcessor in Spring
contentMd:
Q: What is a BeanPostProcessor and how is it used in the framework?

A `BeanPostProcessor` is a Spring extension point that lets you hook into the bean lifecycle and modify or wrap beans after they are instantiated and populated. It defines two callback methods: `postProcessBeforeInitialization` and `postProcessAfterInitialization`, each receiving the bean instance and its name.

The container automatically detects every `BeanPostProcessor` bean and applies it to all other beans during creation. This is exactly how the framework's own features are implemented—for example, `@Autowired` resolution runs through `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor`, and AOP proxy creation happens in `AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator`.

A common use is wrapping beans in proxies for cross-cutting concerns, or customizing behavior such as validating configuration after properties are set. You implement the interface, register it as a bean, and Spring calls your methods for every bean, so you must keep the logic lightweight and avoid expensive work inside it.

Be careful about ordering and dependency cycles. `BeanPostProcessor` instances are instantiated very early, so they cannot rely on other beans being fully initialized, and you should not inject beans that depend on the post-processor itself. For ordered execution, implement `PriorityOrdered` or `Ordered`.
contentCn:
问题：什么是 BeanPostProcessor，它在框架中如何被使用？

`BeanPostProcessor` 是 Spring 的一个扩展点，让你能够钩入 bean 的生命周期，在 bean 被实例化并填充属性之后对其进行修改或包装。它定义了两个回调方法：`postProcessBeforeInitialization` 和 `postProcessAfterInitialization`，二者都会接收 bean 实例及其名称。

容器会自动检测每一个 `BeanPostProcessor` bean，并在创建其他 bean 的过程中应用它。框架自身的诸多特性正是借此实现的——例如 `@Autowired` 的解析由 `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` 完成，而 AOP 代理的创建发生在 `AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator` 中。

一个常见用途是为横切关注点把 bean 包装成代理，或在属性设置后做自定义处理，比如校验配置。你只需实现该接口、把它注册为 bean，Spring 就会对每个 bean 调用你的方法，因此逻辑必须保持轻量，切忌在其中做繁重的工作。

要注意执行顺序与依赖环的问题。`BeanPostProcessor` 实例在很早的阶段就被实例化，因此它们不能依赖其他 bean 已经完全初始化，也不应注入那些又反过来依赖该后处理器的 bean。如需控制顺序，可实现 `PriorityOrdered` 或 `Ordered` 接口。

title: Spring Stereotype Annotations
contentMd:
Q: What are stereotype annotations and how do @Component, @Service, @Repository, and @Controller differ?

Stereotype annotations mark a class as a Spring-managed component so that component scanning picks it up and registers it as a bean. The base annotation is `@Component`; the others are specializations that carry the same bean registration behavior but add semantic meaning and extra features.

`@Service` signals a business-service class holding the application's logic. `@Repository` marks a data-access class and, crucially, enables Spring's exception translation, converting raw JDBC or JPA exceptions into Spring's unified `DataAccessException` hierarchy. `@Controller` denotes a web controller that typically returns a view.

`@RestController` is a convenience composed of `@Controller` and `@ResponseBody`, returning data directly as JSON rather than a view name. Although you could use `@Component` everywhere, the specialized annotations improve readability and are required for certain framework behaviors.

In interviews, note that these annotations only take effect under component scanning (`@ComponentScan` or `@SpringBootApplication`), and that the difference is mostly semantic except for `@Repository`'s exception translation. The actual bean creation is identical across all of them.
contentCn:
问题：什么是构造型注解，@Component、@Service、@Repository、@Controller 之间有何区别？

构造型注解用于把一个类标记为 Spring 管理的组件，从而让组件扫描发现它并注册为 bean。最基础的注解是 `@Component`；其他的都是它的特化版本，既保留了相同的 bean 注册行为，又增加了语义含义和额外的特性。

`@Service` 表示一个承载应用逻辑的业务服务类。`@Repository` 标记数据访问类，并且关键点在于它会启用 Spring 的异常翻译，把原始的 JDBC 或 JPA 异常转换为 Spring 统一的 `DataAccessException` 体系。`@Controller` 表示一个通常返回视图的 Web 控制器。

`@RestController` 是 `@Controller` 与 `@ResponseBody` 的组合，直接以 JSON 形式返回数据而非视图名。虽然你可以在任何地方都用 `@Component`，但专用注解提升了可读性，并且某些框架行为也依赖它们。

在面试中要注意：这些注解只有在组件扫描（`@ComponentScan` 或 `@SpringBootApplication`）开启时才生效；除 `@Repository` 的异常翻译外，它们的差异主要停留在语义层面。所有这些注解创建 bean 的实际机制是完全相同的。

title: BeanFactory vs ApplicationContext
contentMd:
Q: What is the difference between BeanFactory and ApplicationContext?

Both are IoC containers, but `BeanFactory` is the most basic interface, providing core dependency injection and bean lookup via `getBean`. It is lightweight and loads beans lazily, meaning a bean is created only when it is first requested, which saves memory at startup.

`ApplicationContext` is a sub-interface of `BeanFactory` that adds enterprise features: internationalization through `MessageSource`, event publishing via `ApplicationEvent`, declarative access to resources, and integration with AOP. It is the container most applications use, especially in Spring Boot.

A key behavioral difference is eager instantiation: by default `ApplicationContext` pre-instantiates all singleton beans at startup so configuration errors surface immediately, whereas `BeanFactory` delays creation until first access. This makes `ApplicationContext` better for catching wiring mistakes early, at the cost of a slightly longer startup time.

In practice you almost always use `ApplicationContext` (for example `AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` or the one Spring Boot creates). `BeanFactory` remains relevant mainly when resources are extremely constrained, such as in embedded or applet environments where every byte matters.
contentCn:
问题：BeanFactory 与 ApplicationContext 有什么区别？

二者都是 IoC 容器，但 `BeanFactory` 是最基础的接口，通过 `getBean` 提供核心的依赖注入与 bean 查找。它非常轻量，并且采用懒加载——即 bean 只在第一次被请求时才创建，从而在启动时节省内存。

`ApplicationContext` 是 `BeanFactory` 的子接口，额外提供了企业级特性：通过 `MessageSource` 实现国际化、通过 `ApplicationEvent` 发布事件、声明式访问资源，以及与 AOP 的集成。它是大多数应用使用的容器，在 Spring Boot 中更是如此。

一个关键的行为差异是预实例化：`ApplicationContext` 默认在启动时就实例化所有单例 bean，以便配置错误能立即暴露；而 `BeanFactory` 会延迟到首次访问才创建。这使得 `ApplicationContext` 更擅长及早发现装配错误，代价是启动时间略长。

在实际开发中，你几乎总是使用 `ApplicationContext`（例如 `AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` 或 Spring Boot 所创建的容器）。`BeanFactory` 主要在资源极度受限的场景（如嵌入式或 applet 环境）仍有意义，那种情况下每一字节都很关键。
titleCn: BeanFactory 与 ApplicationContext 的区别

title: The @Transactional Self-Invocation Pitfall
contentMd:
Q: Why doesn't @Transactional work when I call another transactional method in the same class?

This is the classic self-invocation problem caused by Spring's proxy-based AOP. When you call `this.methodB()` from inside `methodA` of the same bean, the call goes directly to the target object, completely bypassing the proxy that holds the transactional advice.

Because the proxy is what opens and commits the transaction, a direct `this` call never triggers it. So even if `methodB` is annotated with `@Transactional`, no transaction is started, and any database operation inside it runs without transactional guarantees, often leading to surprising data inconsistencies.

There are several ways to fix it. The cleanest is to move `methodB` into a separate bean and inject it, so the call travels through the proxy. Alternatively, you can inject the bean into itself via `ApplicationContext` or `ObjectProvider` and call the method on that reference, or use AspectJ's compile-time weaving, which does not rely on proxies.

In interviews, use this example to demonstrate real understanding of how Spring AOP works under the hood. The fix is not to add more annotations but to ensure the call passes through the proxy or to switch to a weaving model that intercepts the actual method invocation.
contentCn:
问题：为什么在同一个类中调用另一个事务方法时，@Transactional 不生效？

这是 Spring 基于代理的 AOP 所带来的经典自调用问题。当你在同一个 bean 的 `methodA` 内部调用 `this.methodB()` 时，调用会直接落到目标对象上，完全绕过了携带事务增强的代理。

由于开启和提交事务的正是代理，直接的 `this` 调用永远不会触发它。因此，即便 `methodB` 标注了 `@Transactional`，也不会开启任何事务，其中的数据库操作都在没有事务保证的情况下运行，常常导致令人意外的数据不一致。

有几种修复方式。最干净的做法是把 `methodB` 移到另一个 bean 中并注入进来，这样调用就会经过代理。或者，你可以通过 `ApplicationContext` 或 `ObjectProvider` 把 bean 注入自身，并在这个引用上调用方法；也可以使用 AspectJ 的编译期织入，它不依赖代理。

在面试中，可以用这个例子来展现你对 Spring AOP 底层原理的真正理解。修复之道不在于添加更多注解，而在于确保调用经过代理，或者切换到能拦截实际方法调用的织入模型。

title: JDK Dynamic Proxy vs CGLIB
contentMd:
Q: What is the difference between JDK dynamic proxies and CGLIB proxies in Spring?

Spring AOP needs to create a proxy around your bean, and it chooses between two technologies. JDK dynamic proxying builds a proxy that implements the same interfaces as the target, using reflection through the `java.lang.reflect.Proxy` API. It requires the target to implement at least one interface and only intercepts interface methods.

CGLIB (Code Generation Library) creates a subclass of the target class at runtime and overrides its methods to add the advice. Because it works by subclassing, it can proxy classes with no interfaces, but it cannot proxy `final` classes or `final` methods, since they cannot be overridden.

Historically, Spring used JDK proxies by default when an interface was present and CGLIB otherwise. Since Spring 5.2, the default for both cases is CGLIB, which avoids inconsistency and the need to design every bean around interfaces. You can still force JDK proxies with `proxyTargetClass=false`.

A practical pitfall is that CGLIB proxies call the constructor of the target class twice in some scenarios, and that methods marked `final` are silently not advised. When explaining in interviews, stress that the choice affects which methods can be intercepted and whether your design must rely on interfaces.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中 JDK 动态代理与 CGLIB 代理有何区别？

Spring AOP 需要在 bean 周围创建代理，它会在两种技术之间做选择。JDK 动态代理通过 `java.lang.reflect.Proxy` API 利用反射，构建一个与目标实现相同接口的代理。它要求目标至少实现一个接口，并且只能拦截接口方法。

CGLIB（Code Generation Library）在运行时创建目标类的子类，并重写其方法以附加增强。由于它基于子类化工作，因此可以代理没有接口的类，但它无法代理 `final` 类或 `final` 方法，因为这些无法被重写。

在历史上，Spring 在有接口时使用 JDK 代理，否则使用 CGLIB。从 Spring 5.2 起，两种情况下默认都使用 CGLIB，这避免了不一致，也免去了让每个 bean 都围绕接口设计的需求。你仍可通过 `proxyTargetClass=false` 强制使用 JDK 代理。

一个实际陷阱是：CGLIB 代理在某些情况下会调用目标类构造器两次，而且标记为 `final` 的方法会被静默地不增强。在面试中讲解时，要强调这一选择会影响哪些方法可以被拦截，以及你的设计是否必须依赖接口。
titleCn: JDK 动态代理与 CGLIB 代理

title: @Component vs @Bean
contentMd:
Q: When should I use @Component and when should I use @Bean?

`@Component` is a class-level annotation that you put directly on your own classes. Combined with component scanning, Spring automatically detects and registers these classes as beans. It is the natural choice for the classes you write inside your application, such as services and controllers.

`@Bean` is a method-level annotation placed inside a `@Configuration` class. The method returns an object, and Spring registers that returned instance as a bean. This is how you integrate third-party or legacy classes you cannot annotate, such as a `DataSource`, a `RestTemplate`, or a library client.

A useful distinction is control: `@Component` relies on Spring using its own instantiation logic (a constructor), while `@Bean` lets you write arbitrary Java code to build the object, including conditional setup and calls to other beans. `@Bean` methods can also return an interface type with a concrete implementation chosen at runtime.

In interviews, mention that `@Bean` lives in `@Configuration` (or `@Component`) classes and supports lifecycle and scoping declaratively, whereas `@Component` is scanned. Both ultimately produce beans in the same container; the difference is who controls the creation code—you, via a method, or Spring, via scanning.
contentCn:
问题：何时使用 @Component，何时使用 @Bean？

`@Component` 是一个类级别的注解，直接标注在你自己的类上。配合组件扫描，Spring 会自动发现这些类并把它们注册为 bean。它是为应用内部你编写的类（如 service 和 controller）做选择时的自然之选。

`@Bean` 是方法级别的注解，放在 `@Configuration` 类内部。该方法返回一个对象，Spring 将返回的这个实例注册为 bean。当你要整合无法标注注解的第三方类或遗留类（如 `DataSource`、`RestTemplate` 或某个库客户端）时，就需要用到它。

一个有价值的区别是控制权：`@Component` 依赖 Spring 使用它自己的实例化逻辑（构造器），而 `@Bean` 让你编写任意 Java 代码来构建对象，包括条件化配置和对其他 bean 的调用。`@Bean` 方法还可以返回接口类型，并在运行时选择具体的实现。

在面试中可提到：`@Bean` 位于 `@Configuration`（或 `@Component`）类中，并支持以声明方式指定生命周期与作用域；而 `@Component` 是扫描得到的。二者最终都在同一个容器中产生 bean，区别在于创建代码由谁控制——是你通过一个方法，还是由 Spring 通过扫描。

title: Spring Boot Auto-Configuration
contentMd:
Q: How does Spring Boot auto-configuration work?

Auto-configuration means Spring Boot automatically sets up beans based on the libraries present on the classpath, so you rarely write manual configuration. It is driven by `@EnableAutoConfiguration`, which `@SpringBootApplication` includes, and by the file `META-INF/spring.factories` (or the newer `AutoConfiguration.imports`).

At startup, Spring Boot inspects the classpath and evaluates many `@Conditional` annotations attached to auto-configuration classes. For example, if `DataSource` and a JDBC driver are present, `DataSourceAutoConfiguration` creates a `DataSource` bean with sensible defaults; if you defined your own, the auto-config backs off.

The key mechanism is conditionality: annotations like `@ConditionalOnClass`, `@ConditionalOnMissingBean`, and `@ConditionalOnProperty` decide whether a bean is created. This lets auto-configuration provide defaults while still allowing you to override any part by declaring your own bean or setting a property.

In interviews, stress that auto-configuration is convention over configuration, not magic—it is plain Spring conditionals plus classpath detection. Use `spring-boot-autoconfigure` report or the `/conditions` actuator endpoint to see which auto-configurations were applied or skipped and why, which is invaluable for debugging.
contentCn:
问题：Spring Boot 的自动配置是如何工作的？

自动配置意味着 Spring Boot 会根据 classpath 上存在的库自动装配 bean，因此你很少需要手写配置。它由 `@EnableAutoConfiguration` 驱动（该注解已包含在 `@SpringBootApplication` 中），并依赖 `META-INF/spring.factories` 文件（或更新的 `AutoConfiguration.imports`）。

启动时，Spring Boot 检查 classpath，并评估附加在自动配置类上的众多 `@Conditional` 注解。例如，若同时存在 `DataSource` 和 JDBC 驱动，`DataSourceAutoConfiguration` 就会以合理的默认值创建一个 `DataSource` bean；如果你已定义了自己的，自动配置便会退让。

其核心机制是条件化：`@ConditionalOnClass`、`@ConditionalOnMissingBean`、`@ConditionalOnProperty` 等注解决定某个 bean 是否被创建。这让自动配置能提供默认值，同时仍允许你通过声明自己的 bean 或设置属性来覆盖任何部分。

在面试中，要强调自动配置是“约定优于配置”而非魔法——它不过是普通的 Spring 条件判断加上 classpath 检测。可使用 `spring-boot-autoconfigure` 报告或 `/conditions` 这个 actuator 端点，查看哪些自动配置被应用或跳过及其原因，这对排障极为宝贵。

title: Lazy vs Eager Bean Initialization
contentMd:
Q: What is lazy initialization in Spring, and when would you use it?

By default, an `ApplicationContext` creates all singleton beans eagerly at startup, which surfaces wiring errors early but increases startup time and memory use. Lazy initialization defers the creation of a bean until the first time it is actually requested.

You enable it per bean with `@Lazy` on the bean definition, or globally via `spring.main.lazy-initialization=true` in Spring Boot. A lazily initialized singleton is created only when something first depends on it or calls `getBean`, so unused beans may never be instantiated at all.

Lazy loading is useful for optional or rarely used components, or to speed up application startup. However, it trades a faster boot for a slower first request, because the bean's construction and dependency graph are resolved on demand, and configuration mistakes may only appear later in production.

In interviews, contrast lazy with the normal eager default and note the interaction with `@Lazy` on injection points. Marking a `@Autowired` field as `@Lazy` injects a lazy-resolution proxy, so the dependency is not created until the proxy is first used—handy for breaking startup cycles or deferring heavy resources.
contentCn:
问题：Spring 中的懒加载初始化是什么，何时应该使用它？

默认情况下，`ApplicationContext` 会在启动时预加载地创建所有单例 bean，这能及早暴露装配错误，但会增加启动时间和内存占用。懒加载则把 bean 的创建推迟到它第一次被真正请求时。

你可以在 bean 定义上使用 `@Lazy` 逐 bean 地启用它，或在 Spring Boot 中通过 `spring.main.lazy-initialization=true` 全局启用。被懒加载的单例只有在某处首次依赖它或调用 `getBean` 时才会被创建，因此未被使用的 bean 可能永远都不会被实例化。

懒加载适用于可选或很少使用的组件，或用于加速应用启动。但它以更快的启动换取了首次请求更慢，因为 bean 的构造与依赖图是按需解析的，配置错误也可能直到生产环境后期才暴露。

在面试中，要把懒加载与默认的预加载进行对比，并注意它在注入点上的相互作用。把 `@Autowired` 字段标记为 `@Lazy` 会注入一个惰性解析代理，于是该依赖直到代理首次被使用才创建——这对打破启动期的循环依赖或延迟加载重量级资源很有帮助。
titleCn: Bean 的懒加载与预加载初始化

title: How MySQL Indexes Use B+ Trees
contentMd:
When an interviewer asks how a MySQL index works, the honest answer is: it is a B+ tree. A B+ tree is a balanced tree where every leaf sits at the same depth, so a lookup, insertion, or deletion is always roughly logarithmic in the number of rows. That predictable cost is exactly why indexes stay fast even as tables grow to millions of rows.

Unlike a binary tree, each B+ tree node holds many keys and child pointers, which keeps the tree shallow. The internal (non-leaf) nodes store only keys and routing information to guide the search, while the leaf nodes store the indexed value plus a pointer to the actual row. The leaves are also linked together in a doubly linked list, so a range scan such as WHERE id BETWEEN 100 AND 200 becomes a single walk along the leaves instead of many random seeks.

In InnoDB the primary key is a clustered index, meaning the leaf holds the whole row; secondary indexes store the primary key value, so a lookup through a secondary index needs a second step to fetch the row. This is why a wide primary key makes every secondary index larger. Understanding the B+ tree shape explains most index behavior: why leftmost prefix matching matters, why random inserts can cause page splits, and why covering indexes avoid the extra row fetch.
contentCn:
当面试官问“MySQL 索引是怎么工作的”时，诚实的回答是：它是一棵 B+ 树。B+ 树是一种平衡树，所有叶子节点都处在同一深度，因此查找、插入、删除的代价都大致与行数成对数关系。这种可预测的成本，正是索引即便在表增长到数百万行时依然很快的原因。

与二叉树不同，B+ 树的每个节点都持有大量键值和子节点指针，这让树始终保持很矮。内部（非叶子）节点只存放键值和用于导航的路由信息，而叶子节点存放被索引的值以及一个指向真实行的指针。叶子节点之间还用双向链表串起来，因此像 WHERE id BETWEEN 100 AND 200 这样的范围扫描，只需沿着叶子走一遍即可，而不必做多次随机寻址。

在 InnoDB 中，主键就是聚簇索引（clustered index），也就是说叶子节点直接存整行数据；二级索引则存放主键值，因此通过二级索引查一行还需要再多走一步去取行数据。这也解释了为什么过宽的主键会让每一个二级索引都变大。理解了 B+ 树的形态，就能解释索引的大部分行为：为什么最左前缀匹配很重要、为什么随机插入可能引发页分裂，以及为什么覆盖索引可以省掉那次额外的取行。
titleEn: How MySQL Indexes Use B+ Trees
titleCn: MySQL 索引如何使用 B+ 树

title: Transaction Isolation Levels Explained
contentMd:
Isolation levels decide how much one transaction can see of another's uncommitted work. The SQL standard defines four: read uncommitted, read committed, repeatable read, and serializable. Each higher level prevents more anomalies but usually costs more in locking or waiting.

The classic phenomena are dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads. A dirty read sees data another transaction has not yet committed and may later roll back. A non-repeatable read means the same row returns different values on two reads within one transaction. A phantom read means a query's set of rows changes because another transaction inserted or deleted matching rows. Read committed prevents dirty reads, repeatable read prevents the first two, and serializable prevents all three by effectively running transactions one at a time.

In practice MySQL's InnoDB defaults to repeatable read and uses MVCC plus gap locks to also avoid phantoms at that level, so the practical gap between repeatable read and serializable is smaller than the standard suggests. Spring lets you set the level with @Transactional(isolation = ...), but remember the database ultimately enforces it. Picking the lowest level that keeps your data correct is usually the right move for throughput.
contentCn:
隔离级别决定了一个事务能看见另一个事务多少未提交的工作。SQL 标准定义了四种：读未提交（read uncommitted）、读已提交（read committed）、可重复读（repeatable read）和可串行化（serializable）。每提高一个级别，能避免的异常就更多，但通常要在加锁或等待上付出更高代价。

经典的异常现象有三种：脏读、不可重复读和幻读。脏读会看到另一个事务尚未提交、且可能回滚的数据。不可重复读指在同一个事务内两次读取同一行却得到不同值。幻读指因为别的事务插入或删除了符合条件的行，导致某次查询返回的行集合发生了变化。读已提交能避免脏读，可重复读能避免前两者，而可串行化通过让事务几乎逐个执行来避免全部三种异常。

在实践中，MySQL 的 InnoDB 默认是可重复读，并通过 MVCC 加间隙锁（gap lock）在该级别下也避免了幻读，因此可重复读与可串行化之间的实际差距比标准描述的要小。Spring 允许用 @Transactional(isolation = ...) 设置级别，但要记住最终是由数据库来强制实施的。选择“能保住数据正确性的最低级别”，通常才是吞吐量的正确取舍。

title: Understanding MVCC in MySQL
contentMd:
MVCC, or multi-version concurrency control, is the trick that lets readers and writers not block each other in InnoDB. Instead of locking a row away from every other transaction, InnoDB keeps older versions of the row and shows each transaction the snapshot that was valid when it started. A long-running read therefore never waits for an in-progress write.

The mechanism rests on two hidden columns: a transaction id marking who wrote each version, and a rollback pointer chaining versions together in an undo log. When a transaction reads a row, InnoDB walks the version chain and picks the newest version whose writer had committed before the reader's snapshot. Rows visible only to uncommitted or future transactions are skipped. This is what delivers consistent, non-blocking reads at the repeatable read level.

MVCC is not free. Old versions cannot be deleted until no live transaction still needs them, so a very long transaction forces InnoDB to retain a growing undo log, which bloats storage and slows subsequent reads. That is why you should keep transactions short and avoid holding one open while you loop or call a slow remote service. Periodically purging obsolete versions keeps the history from growing without bound.
contentCn:
MVCC（多版本并发控制，multi-version concurrency control）是 InnoDB 让读和写互不阻塞的诀窍。它并不是把一行锁死、不让其他事务碰，而是保留该行的旧版本，并向每个事务展示它开始那一刻有效的快照。因此，一个长时间运行的读永远不会去等一个正在进行中的写。

这套机制建立在两个隐藏列之上：一个是标记“谁写入了该版本”的事务 id，另一个是指向旧版本的回滚指针，这些版本在 undo log 中串成一条链。当一个事务读取某行时，InnoDB 会沿着版本链往前走，挑出“写入者在该事务快照之前已经提交”的最新版本；那些只对未提交或未来事务可见的行则被跳过。正是它，在可重复读级别下提供了既一致又非阻塞的读。

MVCC 并非没有代价。只要还有存活的事务需要旧版本，那些旧版本就不能被删除，因此一个超长的事务会迫使 InnoDB 保留不断膨胀的 undo log，既撑大存储，又拖慢后续读取。这也解释了为什么应当让事务尽量短小，千万别在循环或调用缓慢的远程服务时还把一个事务开着。定期清理掉过时的版本，才能防止历史无限增长。
titleCn: 深入理解 MySQL 中的 MVCC

title: Diagnosing Slow Queries with EXPLAIN
contentMd:
When a query is slow, the first move is to prefix it with EXPLAIN and read what the optimizer intends to do. EXPLAIN shows the access path: which table is read first, whether an index is used, how many rows the optimizer expects to examine, and whether a temporary table or filesort is needed. These clues point straight at the bottleneck.

The two columns to read first are type and key. The type column shows the join strategy, ranging from ALL (a full table scan) through range and ref up to const; a higher value generally means fewer rows touched. The key column shows which index was actually chosen, and a NULL there means no index was used at all. A large value in the rows column tells you the optimizer expects to scan many candidates, which is where an index or a rewritten condition usually helps.

Beyond EXPLAIN, enable the slow query log to capture real production queries and use EXPLAIN ANALYZE (or the classic profiling) to see actual execution time versus estimates. Common fixes are adding a composite index that matches the WHERE and ORDER BY order, avoiding functions on indexed columns, and replacing SELECT * with only the needed columns. Remember that the optimizer estimates from statistics, so keep them fresh with ANALYZE TABLE after big data changes.
contentCn:
当某条查询很慢时，第一步就是给它加上 EXPLAIN 前缀，看看优化器打算怎么执行。EXPLAIN 会展示访问路径：哪张表先被读取、是否用到了索引、优化器预计要扫描多少行，以及是否需要临时表或文件排序。这些线索会直接把你引向瓶颈所在。

最先要看的两列是 type 和 key。type 列展示连接策略，从 ALL（全表扫描）到 range、ref，再到 const 不等；数值越靠上，通常意味着触碰的行越少。key 列显示实际选用了哪个索引，如果是 NULL 就说明根本没用索引。rows 列数值很大，则说明优化器预计要扫描大量候选行，这往往正是加索引或改写条件能见效的地方。

除了 EXPLAIN，还应开启慢查询日志（slow query log）来捕获生产环境里真实的慢 SQL，并用 EXPLAIN ANALYZE（或传统的 profiling）对比实际执行时间与估算值。常见的修法包括：加上一个与 WHERE 和 ORDER BY 顺序相符的联合索引、避免在索引列上使用函数、用只取所需列的查询替换 SELECT *。要记住，优化器是基于统计信息做估算的，因此在大量数据变更后，用 ANALYZE TABLE 保持统计信息新鲜非常关键。
titleCn: 用 EXPLAIN 诊断慢查询

title: Why HikariCP Is the Default Pool
contentMd:
Opening a database connection is expensive: it involves a network round trip, authentication, and session setup. Creating one per request would quickly overwhelm both the application and the database. A connection pool solves this by keeping a set of live connections ready and handing them out as needed, then recycling them when the work is done.

HikariCP became the de facto default in the Spring ecosystem because it is small and fast. It avoids the lock contention and extra object allocation that slowed older pools, and it uses a clever bag data structure plus bytecode-level tricks to hand connections out with minimal overhead. In most benchmarks it delivers the highest throughput and the lowest latency of the common pools.

The settings that matter are maximumPoolSize, which caps concurrency against the database's capacity, and the timeouts that fail fast instead of blocking threads forever. A pool that is too large can actually hurt, because the database has limited CPU and too many concurrent queries contend for it. Tune the size to your workload, monitor connections in use, and let HikariCP's defaults handle the fine details unless profiling shows a specific problem.
contentCn:
建立一条数据库连接非常昂贵：它需要一次网络往返、身份认证以及会话初始化。如果每个请求都新建一条连接，应用和数据库很快都会被压垮。连接池（connection pool）的做法是预先维持一组活跃连接，按需分配出去，用完了再回收复用。

HikariCP 之所以成为 Spring 生态事实上的默认选择，是因为它既小又快。它规避了让旧式连接池变慢的锁竞争和额外对象分配，并借助一种巧妙的 bag 数据结构，加上字节码层面的优化，以极小开销把连接交出去。在大多数基准测试中，它在常见连接池里拿下了最高的吞吐量和最低的延迟。

真正要紧的配置是 maximumPoolSize——它把并发度限制在数据库处理能力之内——以及那些让请求快速失败、而非永久阻塞线程的超时参数。连接池设得过大反而可能有害，因为数据库的 CPU 有限，过多并发查询只会彼此争抢。请按你的实际负载来调大小，监控“使用中连接数”，除非性能剖析暴露了特定问题，否则把细节交给 HikariCP 的默认值即可。
titleEn: Why HikariCP Is the Default Pool
titleCn: 为什么 HikariCP 是默认连接池

title: MyBatis vs JPA/Hibernate
contentMd:
MyBatis and JPA represent two philosophies of talking to the database. MyBatis is a SQL-mapping tool: you write the SQL yourself and bind the result to Java objects. You keep full control of the query, which makes it easy to optimize a complex join or a reporting query that an automatic generator would mangle.

JPA, usually through Hibernate, is a full ORM that maps entities to tables and generates SQL for you. You work with objects and let the provider decide how to persist them, which speeds up CRUD-heavy applications and keeps the code declarative. The cost is a learning curve around caching, lazy loading, and the surprises of generated SQL when a query becomes slow.

There is no universal winner. If your domain is complex and you value hand-tuned SQL and predictable behavior, MyBatis fits. If you want to move fast on standard persistence and accept the abstraction, JPA saves effort. Many teams mix them: JPA for ordinary entities and MyBatis or a jOOQ query for the few hotspots where exact SQL matters. The right choice depends on who maintains the code and how much control you need.
contentCn:
MyBatis 和 JPA 代表了两种与数据库对话的理念。MyBatis 是一个 SQL 映射工具：SQL 由你自己来写，再把结果绑定到 Java 对象上。你完全掌控查询本身，这让优化复杂连接或报表类查询变得容易——那些查询若是交给自动生成器，多半会被弄得很糟。

JPA（通常通过 Hibernate 实现）则是一个完整的 ORM，它把实体映射到表，并替你生成 SQL。你操作的是对象，至于如何持久化由提供方决定，这能加快以增删改查为主的应用开发，也让代码更具声明式风格。代价则是要跨越缓存、懒加载，以及当查询变慢时“自动生成 SQL”的种种 surprises 的学习曲线。

两者没有绝对的赢家。如果你的领域模型复杂，又看重手调 SQL 和可预测的行为，MyBatis 更合适；如果你想在标准持久化上快速推进、愿意接受这层抽象，JPA 能省下不少力气。很多团队会把它们混用：普通实体用 JPA，少数对精确 SQL 有要求的性能热点则交给 MyBatis 或 jOOQ。正确的选择取决于谁来维护代码，以及你到底需要多大程度的掌控。

title: The Pros and Cons of Using an ORM
contentMd:
An ORM like Hibernate lets you treat the database as a graph of Java objects, and that productivity is its biggest draw. Boilerplate CRUD, relationship navigation, and basic queries disappear behind a clean API, so a team can ship features without writing much SQL. For many applications this speed is worth more than perfect control.

The downside is the abstraction leak. The ORM must translate object operations into SQL, and when that translation is opaque you lose sight of what hits the database. A innocent-looking getter can trigger a lazy load that fires a query you never intended; a small change to an entity can cascade into surprising writes. Performance problems then hide behind friendly method names.

The pragmatic advice is to use the ORM where it helps and step around it where it hurts. Keep entities lean, fetch only what you need, and reach for a native query or a lighter mapper on the few paths that must be fast or exact. Knowing both the convenience and the cost is what separates developers who use an ORM well from those who are surprised by it in production.
contentCn:
像 Hibernate 这样的 ORM，让你把数据库当作一张 Java 对象图来对待，而这份生产力正是它最大的吸引力。模板化的增删改查、关系导航和基础查询都藏进了干净的 API 背后，团队因此能在不怎么写 SQL 的情况下交付功能。对很多应用而言，这份速度比完美的掌控更值钱。

缺点在于抽象会“漏水”。ORM 必须把对象操作翻译成 SQL，而当这层翻译不透明时，你就看不见到底有什么打到了数据库上。一个看似无害的 getter 可能触发一次懒加载，从而发起一条你根本没想过的查询；对实体的一处小改动，也可能级联出令人意外的写入。性能问题就这样被友好的方法名给藏了起来。

务实的建议是：在 ORM 有帮助的地方用它，在它带来痛苦的地方绕开它。保持实体精简、只取所需，并在少数必须快或必须精确的路径上改用原生查询或更轻量的映射器。既懂它的便利、又懂它的代价，这正是能把 ORM 用好的开发者，与那些在生产环境被它惊到的人之间的区别。
titleEn: The Pros and Cons of Using an ORM
titleCn: 使用 ORM 的利与弊

title: Clustered vs Secondary Indexes
contentMd:
In InnoDB there is exactly one clustered index, and it is the primary key. The clustered index stores the row data inside the B+ tree leaves, so the primary key lookup goes straight to the row without a second hop. This makes access by primary key the fastest path you have.

Every other index is a secondary index, and its leaf does not hold the row. Instead it holds the primary key value of the matching rows. When you query through a secondary index, InnoDB finds the primary keys in that index and then performs a second lookup, called the bookmark lookup, to fetch the actual row from the clustered index. This extra step is why a query that only needs indexed columns can be far cheaper.

The design has consequences for schema choice. A secondary index is larger when the primary key is wide, because the key is copied into every secondary index entry. An auto-increment integer primary key keeps rows appended in order and makes secondary indexes compact, while a random UUID scatters writes and inflates every index. Choosing a small, monotonic primary key is a quiet but real performance decision.
contentCn:
在 InnoDB 中，聚簇索引（clustered index）有且只有一个，它就是主键。聚簇索引把行数据直接存放在 B+ 树的叶子节点里，因此按主键查找可以一步到位，无需第二次跳转。这也让“按主键访问”成为你手中最快的路径。

其余所有索引都是二级索引（secondary index），它们的叶子并不保存行数据，而是保存匹配行对应的主键值。当你通过二级索引查询时，InnoDB 会先在该索引里找到主键，再执行一次被称为“书签查找（bookmark lookup）”的二次查找，从聚簇索引取回真正的行。正是这一步额外的开销，解释了为什么“只取索引列”的查询会便宜得多。

这种结构对表设计也有影响。当主键很宽时，二级索引也会变大，因为主键会被复制进每一个二级索引条目。自增整型主键让行按顺序追加、二级索引保持紧凑，而随机的 UUID 会把写入打散、并撑大每一个索引。选择一个小而单调递增的主键，是一个无声却真实影响性能的决定。

title: What a Covering Index Saves You
contentMd:
A covering index is one that contains every column a query needs, so the database never has to visit the table at all. The B+ tree leaf already holds the values, and InnoDB can answer the query entirely from the index, which turns a random row fetch into a cheap sequential index read.

This matters because the table lookup, the bookmark lookup, is often the most expensive part. Consider SELECT name FROM users WHERE age > 30; if you create a composite index on (age, name), both the filter and the returned column live in the index. The query becomes an index-only scan and skips the clustered index entirely. The EXPLAIN output shows Using index, which is a strong signal you have a good index for this query.

Building covering indexes is a trade-off. Each extra index slows writes and consumes storage, and a composite index only helps when the column order matches the query's access pattern, especially the leftmost prefix. Use covering indexes deliberately for your hottest read paths, and verify with EXPLAIN rather than assuming an index helps just because one exists.
contentCn:
覆盖索引（covering index）是指：一条查询所需的每一列都包含在该索引中，于是数据库根本不必去访问表。B+ 树的叶子节点本就保存着这些值，InnoDB 可以完全从索引里回答查询，从而把一次随机取行变成一次廉价的顺序索引读。

这点很重要，因为对表的查找（也就是书签查找）往往是最昂贵的部分。设想 SELECT name FROM users WHERE age > 30；如果你建一个 (age, name) 的联合索引，过滤条件和返回列就都在索引里了。这条查询会变成“仅索引扫描”，完全跳过聚簇索引。EXPLAIN 的输出里如果出现 Using index，就是一个强烈信号：你为这条查询建对了索引。

不过，构建覆盖索引也是一种权衡。每多一个索引都会拖慢写入、占用存储，而且联合索引只有在列顺序与查询的访问模式（尤其最左前缀）相符时才有用。请为你最热的读路径刻意使用覆盖索引，并用 EXPLAIN 去验证，而不是仅凭“索引存在”就假设它有用。
titleEn: What a Covering Index Saves You
titleCn: 覆盖索引能帮你省掉什么

title: MyBatis First and Second Level Cache
contentMd:
MyBatis has two cache layers that surprise developers who do not know they exist. The first-level cache is bound to a single SqlSession and is on by default. Within one session, repeating the same query returns the cached result instead of hitting the database again, which can mask a slow query during testing.

The second-level cache is scoped to the mapper namespace and shared across sessions, but it is off by default and must be explicitly enabled. It is more dangerous in practice because it holds data across sessions, so a write from one part of the application can leave another part serving stale results unless every related statement is wired to the same cache and eviction is configured correctly.

In most modern setups the application already uses a shared cache such as Redis, or relies on the database buffer pool, so MyBatis caching adds little and introduces correctness risk. The safe default is to keep the first-level cache in mind while debugging, and to leave the second-level cache disabled unless you have a concrete, measured reason to turn it on. Understanding where results come from prevents confusing bugs.
contentCn:
MyBatis 有两层缓存，常常让不知道它们存在的开发者大吃一惊。一级缓存绑定在单个 SqlSession 上，且默认开启。在同一个会话内，重复执行同一条查询会直接返回缓存结果，而不再访问数据库——这可能在测试阶段把一条慢查询给掩盖掉。

二级缓存的作用域是 mapper 命名空间，可在多个会话间共享，但它默认关闭，必须显式开启。它在实际中更危险，因为它跨会话持有数据：应用中某处的写入，可能让另一处仍在提供过期结果，除非每个相关语句都接到同一个缓存、并且正确配置了淘汰策略。

在大多数现代架构里，应用已经用了 Redis 这类共享缓存，或依赖数据库的缓冲池，因此 MyBatis 的缓存贡献不大，反而带来正确性风险。稳妥的默认做法是：调试时心里记着一级缓存，而二级缓存则保持关闭，除非你有具体、可度量的理由才去开启。搞清楚结果究竟来自哪里，才能避免那些令人困惑的 bug。
titleEn: MyBatis First and Second Level Cache
titleCn: MyBatis 的一级与二级缓存

title: Row Locks, Table Locks, and Gap Locks
contentMd:
Locks are how InnoDB keeps concurrent writes correct. The finest granularity is the row lock, taken on a single indexed row during an update or delete. Row locks let many transactions modify different rows at once, which is why indexing your WHERE clause matters: without an index, InnoDB may have to lock far more rows than you intended, or even fall back to a coarser lock.

Two special locks guard ranges rather than exact rows. A gap lock blocks inserts into the space between existing rows, and a next-key lock combines a row lock with a gap lock on its following interval. These are how InnoDB prevents phantom reads under repeatable read by stopping other transactions from inserting rows that your query would otherwise miss.

Table-level locks are coarser and mostly used by DDL or by storage engines like MyISAM. In InnoDB they are rare but appear during operations such as ALTER TABLE or when metadata is changed. Deadlocks happen when two transactions hold locks the other wants; InnoDB detects this and rolls back one of them. Designing transactions to acquire locks in a consistent order, and to touch rows in the same sequence, sharply reduces deadlock frequency.
contentCn:
锁是 InnoDB 保证并发写入正确性的手段。最细的粒度是行锁（row lock），在 update 或 delete 某条带索引的行时被加上。行锁允许多个事务同时修改不同的行，这也解释了为什么“给 WHERE 条件建索引”如此重要：没有索引，InnoDB 可能不得不锁住比你预期多得多的行，甚至退化为更粗的锁。

还有两种特殊的锁，它们保护的是范围而非确切的行。间隙锁（gap lock）阻止在已有行之间的空隙插入数据；而临键锁（next-key lock）把“行锁 + 其后区间的间隙锁”组合在一起。正是它们，让 InnoDB 在可重复读下通过阻止别的事务插入你查询本该漏掉的行，从而避免幻读。

表级锁粒度更粗，主要由 DDL 或像 MyISAM 这样的存储引擎使用。在 InnoDB 中它们很少出现，但会发生在 ALTER TABLE 或元数据变更等操作时。死锁发生在两个事务各持对方想要的锁之时；InnoDB 会检测到并回滚其中一方。让事务以一致的顺序加锁、并以相同顺序触碰行，能大幅降低死锁出现的频率。
titleEn: Row Locks, Table Locks, and Gap Locks

title: Spring Transaction Propagation
contentMd:
When one @Transactional method calls another, the propagation setting decides how the two transaction boundaries relate. The default, REQUIRED, joins the existing transaction if there is one, and creates a new one only if none exists. This is what most code wants: a single commit or rollback for the whole call chain.

Other settings cover specific needs. REQUIRES_NEW always suspends the outer transaction and starts a fresh one, so the inner work commits or rolls back independently; this is how you keep an audit log even when the main operation fails. NOT_SUPPORTED runs without a transaction by suspending any active one, which is useful for code that must not participate in a transaction. NESTED uses a savepoint so the inner part can roll back on its own while the outer continues.

A frequent trap is that these rules only apply when the method is called through the proxy. A call from one method to another inside the same bean bypasses the proxy, so the annotation is silently ignored and no new transaction is created. Inject a self-reference or move the method to another bean when you genuinely need separate boundaries. Understanding propagation saves you from data that never rolls back the way you expected.
contentCn:
当一个 @Transactional 方法调用另一个时，传播行为（propagation）决定了这两个事务边界如何关联。默认值是 REQUIRED：如果已存在事务就加入它，只有不存在时才新建一个。这正是大多数代码想要的：整条调用链一次提交或回滚。

其他设置则应对特定需求。REQUIRES_NEW 总是挂起外层事务、开启一个全新的事务，因此内层工作会独立提交或回滚——你正可以用它来在主操作失败时仍保留审计日志。NOT_SUPPORTED 会挂起任何活跃事务、在无事务状态下运行，适用于绝不能参与事务的代码。NESTED 使用保存点（savepoint），让内层可独自回滚，而外层继续。

一个常见的陷阱是：这些规则只在“通过代理调用方法”时生效。同一个 bean 内一个方法直接调用另一个方法会绕过代理，于是注解被悄悄忽略、新事务并不会创建。当你确实需要独立的事务边界时，应注入自身引用（self-reference），或把方法挪到另一个 bean 上。理解传播行为，能让你免于面对“数据根本没有按预期回滚”的尴尬。

title: Why an Index Is Not Used
contentMd:
A common interview surprise is a query with an index that still does a full table scan. The usual culprit is applying a function or arithmetic to the indexed column, such as WHERE YEAR(created_at) = 2024 or WHERE amount + 1 > 100. The database cannot use the B+ tree on the raw column because the value it would look up has been transformed, so it scans everything instead.

Implicit type conversion causes the same problem. If a column is a string but you compare it to a number, MySQL silently converts each row, defeating the index. Leading wildcards are another trap: LIKE '%abc' cannot use the index because the prefix is unknown, while LIKE 'abc%' can. Using OR across columns where only some are indexed, or a NOT IN / != condition, can also push the optimizer toward a full scan.

The fix is to keep the indexed column clean on one side of the condition. Rewrite functions into range comparisons, match types exactly, and prefer prefix wildcards. Then confirm with EXPLAIN that the key column is no longer NULL. Treating the index as something the database can only use on the original column value keeps your queries fast.
contentCn:
面试中一个常见的“翻车点”是：明明建了索引，查询却仍是全表扫描。罪魁祸首通常是对索引列套了函数或做了运算，比如 WHERE YEAR(created_at) = 2024 或 WHERE amount + 1 > 100。由于要查找的值被改变了，数据库无法在原始列上使用 B+ 树，只能全部扫描。

隐式类型转换也会造成同样的问题。如果某列是字符串，你却拿数字去比，MySQL 会逐行做静默转换，于是索引失效。前导通配符是另一个坑：LIKE '%abc' 因为前缀未知而无法用索引，而 LIKE 'abc%' 可以。对只有部分列建了索引的多列做 OR，或是使用 NOT IN、!= 这类条件，也会把优化器推向全表扫描。

修法是让索引列在条件的一侧保持“干净”。把函数改写成范围比较、严格匹配类型、并优先用前缀通配符；随后用 EXPLAIN 确认 key 列不再是 NULL。把索引视作“数据库只能在原始列值上使用的东西”，你的查询才能保持快速。
titleEn: Why an Index Is Not Used

title: The Danger of Long Transactions
contentMd:
A long transaction is one that stays open while the application does a lot of non-database work: looping over items, calling another service, or waiting on user input. While it is open, InnoDB must keep the row versions it might need, so the undo log grows and old rows cannot be purged, which slowly inflates the database and slows every reader.

Worse, the transaction holds locks on whatever it touched. A connection with an uncommitted transaction occupies a slot in the pool, and if it blocks on a slow call, those locks are held hostage. Other transactions pile up waiting, connections get exhausted, and a small slowdown can cascade into an outage. This is one of the most common ways a healthy system suddenly falls over.

The remedy is to keep transactions short and close to the database. Do the heavy computing, validation, and remote calls before opening the transaction, then wrap only the minimal set of writes in it, and commit promptly. If you must process many rows, batch them into small transactions rather than one giant unit. Treating the transaction as a tight, database-only bracket is the habit that keeps throughput and stability together.
contentCn:
所谓“大事务（long transaction）”，是指应用在做大量非数据库工作时仍然开着的事务：比如遍历一堆条目、调用另一个服务、或等待用户输入。只要它还开着，InnoDB 就必须保留它可能需要的行版本，于是 undo log 不断膨胀、旧行无法被清理，数据库被慢慢撑大，每个读取者也都随之变慢。

更糟的是，该事务还持有着它所触碰过的锁。一个尚未提交的事务会占住连接池里的一个槽位，而一旦它被某个缓慢的调用卡住，那些锁就被“绑架”了。其他事务排起长队等待、连接被耗尽，一次小小的变慢就可能级联成一次宕机。这也是原本健康的系统突然崩掉最常见的情形之一。

解法是让事务尽量短小、并且紧贴数据库。在开启事务之前，先把繁重的计算、校验和远程调用做完，然后只把最小范围的写入包进事务、并尽快提交。如果你必须处理大量行，就把它们分批成多个小事务，而不是一个巨大的单元。把事务当作一个“紧贴数据库、范围紧凑”的括号，才是让吞吐与稳定兼得的习惯。

title: The N+1 Query Problem
contentMd:
The N+1 problem is a classic ORM trap. You load a list of N parent entities in one query, then for each parent you access a lazy collection, which fires a separate query to fetch its children. The result is one query for the parents plus N queries for the children, and the database round trips explode as N grows.

It happens because lazy loading defers the child fetch until you actually touch the association. In a loop that renders a page, this turns a single screen into dozens or hundreds of queries, and the latency adds up far from the user's view, hidden behind plain object access. Profilers and the SQL log are usually how teams first notice it.

The fix is to fetch the children up front with a join fetch or an entity graph, so the association is loaded in the same query as the parents. A well-placed @BatchSize can also collapse the N queries into a few batch fetches. The lesson is to think in SQL even when you write objects: decide what data a use case needs and load it in one shape, rather than letting navigation trigger surprise queries one row at a time.
contentCn:
N+1 问题是 ORM 中一个经典的陷阱。你用一条查询加载了 N 个父实体，随后对每一个父实体访问一个懒加载的集合，又会各自发起一条独立查询去取它的子项。结果就是：父实体一条查询，子实体 N 条查询，随着 N 增大，数据库往返次数呈爆炸式增长。

它之所以发生，是因为懒加载会把子项的抓取推迟到“你真正访问该关联”的那一刻。在一个渲染页面的循环里，这会让一个页面背后藏着几十条甚至上百条查询，而这些延迟在用户视野之外悄悄累积，被普普通通的对象访问给掩盖了。团队通常是通过性能剖析工具或 SQL 日志才第一次发现它。

修法是提前用 join fetch 或实体图（entity graph）把子项一次性取出来，让关联与父实体在同一条查询里加载完成。把 @BatchSize 放在合适的位置，也能把 N 条查询压缩成几次批量抓取。其背后的教训是：即便你在写对象，也要用 SQL 的思维方式去想——先想清楚某个用例到底需要什么数据，并一次性按需要的形态加载，而不是放任“导航访问”逐行触发那些意外的查询。

title: Redis Data Structures and When to Use Them
contentMd:
Redis exposes a small set of built-in data structures, and picking the right one is a common interview question. A plain string value can hold text, a number, or a serialized blob, and atomic commands such as INCR make it a convenient counter.

A hash maps field names to values inside a single key, which is ideal for representing an object without serializing the whole thing. A list preserves insertion order and supports push and pop from both ends, so it works as a simple queue or stack. A set stores unique members and answers membership queries in constant time, while a sorted set adds a score to each member so you can retrieve ranges, which is how leaderboards are usually built.

Choosing well means thinking about access patterns. If you need to update one field of a profile, a hash beats rewriting the entire JSON string. If you need the top ten items by score, a sorted set removes the need to sort in your application. Interviewers look for this reasoning rather than a memorized list.
contentCn:
Redis 提供了数量不多的一组内置数据结构，如何选型是常见面试题。普通的字符串（string）值可以存文本、数字或序列化后的对象，配合 INCR 这类原子命令，它天然适合当计数器。

哈希（hash）在一个键内保存字段名到值的映射，非常适合表示对象，而不必把整个对象序列化重写。列表（list）保留插入顺序并支持两端 push/pop，因此可以充当简单的队列或栈。集合（set）存储不重复成员，成员查询是常数时间；有序集合（sorted set）给每个成员附带一个 score，从而支持按区间取数据，排行榜通常就是这么实现的。

选型的关键在于访问模式。如果只更新用户资料里的一个字段，哈希优于重写整个 JSON 字符串；如果需要按分数取前十名，有序集合能省掉在应用层排序的工作。面试官想考察的正是这种基于场景的推理，而不是死记硬背的清单。
titleEn: Redis Data Structures and When to Use Them
titleCn: Redis 数据结构及其适用场景

title: Preventing Cache Penetration
contentMd:
Cache penetration happens when a request asks for data that exists neither in the cache nor in the database. Because the key is never found, every request falls through to the database, and an attacker who generates random keys can drive load straight into your storage layer.

The standard fix is to cache the negative result as well. When a lookup misses the database, store a short-lived placeholder value so repeated requests for the same missing key stop at the cache. A second defense is a bloom filter placed in front of the database: it answers with certainty that a key is absent, and only probable membership requests continue to the store.

Both techniques trade a little memory for a large reduction in database pressure. In an interview, mention that the placeholder needs a short expiration, otherwise genuinely new data can never become visible. Parameter validation on the request also helps, since it rejects obviously invalid identifiers before they reach the cache at all.
contentCn:
缓存穿透（cache penetration）指的是请求查询的数据既不在缓存里、也不存在于数据库中。由于这个键永远查不到，每一次请求都会落到数据库上；一旦有人批量构造随机键发起攻击，流量就会直接打到存储层。

标准解法是把空结果也缓存起来。当查询在数据库中也未命中时，写入一个短期存活的占位值，这样对同一个不存在键的重复请求就会止步于缓存。第二道防线是在数据库前面放一个布隆过滤器（bloom filter）：它能确定地回答某个键一定不存在，只有判定为可能存在的请求才继续访问存储。

这两种做法都是用少量内存换取数据库压力的大幅下降。面试时可以补充一点：占位值必须设置较短的过期时间，否则真正新增的数据将永远无法被看到。对请求参数做校验同样有帮助，因为明显非法的标识符会在到达缓存之前就被拒掉。

title: Cache Breakdown on a Hot Key
contentMd:
Cache breakdown describes a different failure: a single hot key expires, and because that key receives enormous traffic, all its requests hit the database at once. Unlike an avalanche, which takes down many keys, breakdown concerns one extremely popular entry.

A common remedy is a mutex or single-flight lock. When a request finds the cache empty, it acquires a lock, rebuilds the value from the database, writes it back, and releases the lock. Concurrent requests either wait briefly or fall back to a stale value, so only one thread ever talks to the database.

Another approach is to avoid expiry entirely for hot keys by refreshing them asynchronously with a background job, or by using a logical expiration timestamp stored inside the value. The application serves the old data while a worker recomputes it. Explaining both the lock and the logical-expiry pattern shows you understand the trade-off between latency and freshness.
contentCn:
缓存击穿（cache breakdown）描述的是另一种失效场景：某个极热点的键过期了，由于它承载着海量流量，所有相关请求会在同一时刻涌向数据库。与雪崩不同，雪崩是大量键同时失效，而击穿只针对那一个访问量极高的条目。

常见的补救手段是互斥锁或 single-flight 机制。当请求发现缓存为空时，先获取锁，再从数据库重建数据、写回缓存、最后释放锁。并发的请求要么短暂等待，要么先返回旧值，从而保证始终只有一个线程去访问数据库。

另一种思路是让热点键干脆不过期：由后台任务异步刷新，或在值内部携带一个逻辑过期时间戳。应用继续返回旧数据，同时由工作线程重新计算。面试时把加锁方案与逻辑过期方案都讲出来，能体现你理解延迟与新鲜度之间的取舍。
titleEn: Cache Breakdown on a Hot Key

title: Surviving a Cache Avalanche
contentMd:
A cache avalanche occurs when a large number of keys expire at the same moment, often because they were written together with an identical time to live. The cache suddenly offers almost nothing, and the entire application load shifts to the database within seconds.

The simplest prevention is to randomize expiration. Instead of a fixed thirty minute TTL, add a random jitter of a few minutes so keys expire gradually instead of in one wave. Keeping a second layer of cache with different lifetimes, or making a subset of keys permanent and refreshing them in the background, adds further resilience.

Beyond expiry, teams protect the database with rate limiting and circuit breakers so a cache failure degrades the service instead of destroying it. In an interview, emphasize that the root cause is synchronized lifetimes, and that jitter is a surprisingly cheap and effective fix.
contentCn:
缓存雪崩（cache avalanche）指的是大量键在同一时刻集体失效，往往是因为它们写入时被设置了完全相同的存活时间（TTL）。缓存几乎瞬间失去作用，整个应用的流量会在几秒内全部压到数据库上。

最简单的预防手段是给过期时间加随机抖动（jitter）。与其固定三十分钟 TTL，不如额外加上几分钟的随机值，让键分批过期而不是一次性集中失效。再叠加一层不同生命周期的二级缓存，或让一部分键永久有效并由后台刷新，可以进一步提升韧性。

除了过期问题，团队还会用限流和熔断器保护数据库，让缓存失效时服务是降级而不是崩溃。面试时应强调：根因是过期时间被同步了，而加随机抖动是一个成本低得惊人却非常有效的修复手段。

title: Cache and Database Consistency
contentMd:
Keeping a cache consistent with the database is a classic interview trap. The naive approach updates the cache first and the database second, but if the second write fails, the cache now serves a value that never existed and every read returns wrong data.

Most teams therefore update the database first and then delete the cache entry, letting the next read repopulate it. Deleting is safer than rewriting because a concurrent reader cannot write a stale computed value back after your update. This is known as the cache-aside or lazy-loading pattern, and it tolerates the small window where a read may still see old data.

For stronger guarantees you can use a message queue to retry the deletion, subscribe to a change data capture stream, or accept a bounded staleness window with a short TTL. Interviewers rarely expect perfect consistency; they want you to state the trade-off, explain why deleting beats updating, and show how delayed double-delete reduces the stale window further.
contentCn:
如何让缓存与数据库保持一致是经典面试陷阱。最朴素的做法是先更新缓存、再更新数据库，但如果第二步写失败，缓存里就留下了一个从未真实存在过的值，之后每次读都会返回错误数据。

因此多数团队的做法是：先更新数据库，再删除缓存条目，由下一次读取来重建缓存。删除比回写更安全，因为在你的更新之后，并发的读请求不会把一个过时的计算结果写回缓存。这就是所谓的 cache-aside（旁路缓存 / 懒加载）模式，它容忍极短时间内读到旧数据这个窗口。

如果需要更强的保证，可以用消息队列重试删除、订阅变更数据捕获（CDC）流，或者接受一个有界的过期窗口并配合较短的 TTL。面试官通常并不要求强一致，而是希望你讲清取舍：为什么删除优于回写，以及延迟双删如何进一步缩小陈旧数据的窗口。

title: Building a Redis Distributed Lock
contentMd:
A distributed lock coordinates access to a shared resource across multiple JVMs. With Redis, the basic recipe is to set a key only if it does not exist, with an expiration time so the lock is released even if the holder crashes.

Several details separate a correct lock from a broken one. Setting the value and the expiration must happen in a single atomic command, otherwise a crash between the two leaves a lock that never expires. The value should be a unique token so that only the owner may release the lock; without it, a slow process can delete a lock that another process has since acquired. Finally, releasing must compare the token and delete atomically, which is usually done with a small Lua script.

Redlock extends this by acquiring the lock on several independent Redis instances and requiring a majority, at the cost of significant complexity. In an interview, note that for most business systems a single well-implemented Redis lock with a token and expiry is sufficient, and that database unique constraints or optimistic versioning are often simpler alternatives.
contentCn:
分布式锁用于协调多个 JVM 对共享资源的访问。基于 Redis 的基本做法是：仅在键不存在时写入，并同时设置过期时间，这样即使持锁方崩溃，锁也最终会自动释放。

正确的锁与有缺陷的锁之间差在几个细节。设值和设过期必须放在同一条原子命令里完成，否则两步之间崩溃会留下一个永不过期的锁。值应当是一个唯一令牌（token），保证只有持有者才能释放锁；否则一个慢进程可能删掉别的进程后来才拿到的锁。最后，释放锁必须比对令牌再删除并且是原子的，通常用一小段 Lua 脚本实现。

Redlock 的做法是在多个互相独立的 Redis 实例上加锁并要求多数派成功，代价是复杂度显著上升。面试时可以指出：对多数业务系统而言，一个实现了令牌与过期时间的单实例 Redis 锁已经足够，而数据库唯一约束或乐观版本号往往是更简单的替代方案。
titleCn: 基于 Redis 实现分布式锁

title: Redis Expiration and Eviction
contentMd:
Redis supports two different ways of removing data: expiration driven by time to live, and eviction driven by memory pressure. Understanding the difference is a frequent interview question.

For expiration, Redis removes an expired key either when it is accessed, or proactively by sampling a small set of keys periodically and deleting those that have passed their deadline. This sampling keeps the overhead bounded rather than scanning the whole keyspace. Eviction is different: when maxmemory is reached, Redis must free space, and the configured policy decides whether to remove the least recently used keys, the least frequently used ones, random keys, or to refuse writes altogether.

The practical advice is to always set a TTL on cache data, choose an eviction policy that matches your workload, and monitor evicted key counts. If eviction happens constantly, your working set no longer fits in memory, and the correct answer is usually to scale the cache or reduce what you store, not to tweak the policy endlessly.
contentCn:
Redis 有两种不同的数据移除方式：由存活时间（TTL）驱动的过期，以及由内存压力驱动的淘汰。理解二者的区别是常见的面试问题。

过期方面，Redis 要么在键被访问时才发现并删除它，要么通过定期抽样一小批键、删掉其中已过期的那些来主动清理。这种抽样把开销控制在有界范围内，而不必扫描整个键空间。淘汰则不同：当达到 maxmemory 上限时，Redis 必须腾出空间，具体策略由配置决定——可以移除最近最少使用（LRU）的键、最不经常使用（LFU）的键、随机键，或者直接拒绝写入。

实践建议是：始终给缓存数据设置 TTL，选择契合业务负载的淘汰策略，并监控被淘汰键的数量。如果淘汰频繁发生，说明你的工作集已经装不进内存了；此时正确的应对通常是扩容缓存或减少存储内容，而不是无休止地微调策略。
titleCn: Redis 的过期与淘汰机制

title: Redis Persistence with RDB and AOF
contentMd:
Redis keeps data in memory, so persistence is about recovering that state after a restart. Two mechanisms exist, and interviewers often ask how they differ.

RDB takes a point-in-time snapshot of the dataset at configured intervals. It is compact and fast to load, but a crash between snapshots loses everything written since the last one. AOF appends every write operation to a log and replays it on startup; it loses far less data and can be configured to flush every second or on every command, at the cost of a larger file and slower restarts.

Most production deployments enable both: AOF for durability and RDB for convenient backups and fast restarts. Redis can also rewrite the AOF in the background so the log does not grow forever. When answering, mention that neither mechanism turns Redis into a primary database of record, and that replication to replicas is a separate concern from writing to disk.
contentCn:
Redis 把数据放在内存里，因此持久化要解决的其实是重启后如何恢复状态。它提供两种机制，面试官经常追问二者的区别。

RDB 按配置的时间间隔对数据集做一次时间点快照（snapshot）。它文件紧凑、加载速度快，但如果在两次快照之间宕机，这期间写入的数据会全部丢失。AOF 则把每一条写操作追加到日志中，启动时重放；它丢失的数据少得多，并且可以配置为每秒刷盘或每条命令都刷盘，代价是文件更大、重启更慢。

多数生产环境会同时开启两者：用 AOF 保证持久性，用 RDB 做便捷备份和快速重启。Redis 还能在后台重写 AOF，避免日志无限增长。回答时可以指出：这两种机制都不会让 Redis 变成可信赖的记录型主库，而且把数据复制到从节点（replication）与写入磁盘是两个不同的关注点。
titleEn: Redis Persistence with RDB and AOF
titleCn: Redis 的 RDB 与 AOF 持久化

title: Redis Replication and Cluster Mode
contentMd:
Scaling Redis begins with replication. A replica keeps a copy of the primary data and can serve read traffic, which spreads load and provides a failover target when the primary fails.

Sharding goes further by splitting the keyspace across several nodes. Redis Cluster divides the space into hash slots and assigns ranges of slots to each node, so a client is redirected to the node that owns the key. Sentinel is a lighter alternative that monitors primaries and promotes a replica automatically, but it does not shard data.

The interview point is that cluster mode changes what you can do: multi-key operations are only allowed when all keys live in the same hash slot, which is why hash tags exist. Also note that replication is asynchronous, so failover can lose a small amount of acknowledged data, and that Redis Cluster is not a strong-consistency system.
contentCn:
扩展 Redis 的第一步是复制（replication）。从节点（replica）保存主节点数据的副本，并可以承接读流量，这既分摊了负载，也在主节点故障时提供了切换的目标。

分片（sharding）更进一步，把键空间拆分到多个节点上。Redis Cluster 把键空间划分为若干哈希槽（hash slot），并把不同范围的槽分配给各节点，客户端会被重定向到真正拥有该键的节点。Sentinel 是更轻量的替代方案，它监控主节点并自动提升从节点，但不做数据分片。

面试要点在于：集群模式会改变可用操作——只有当所有键都落在同一个哈希槽里时，多键操作才被允许，哈希标签（hash tag）正是为此而生。另外要注意复制是异步的，故障切换可能丢失少量已确认的数据，而且 Redis Cluster 并不是一个强一致系统。

title: Why Use a Message Queue
contentMd:
A message queue sits between services and lets them communicate without calling each other directly. The producer writes a message and continues immediately; the consumer reads it later at its own pace.

This decoupling gives three practical benefits. It smooths traffic spikes because the queue buffers work instead of overwhelming a downstream service. It improves reliability since a consumer that is temporarily down can process the backlog after it recovers. And it enables fan-out, where several independent consumers react to the same event without the producer knowing about them.

The cost is eventual consistency and extra operational surface: you now must reason about duplicates, ordering, and failures. Interviewers like candidates who state both sides, and who mention that a queue is a tool for asynchrony and buffering rather than a universal answer to every coupling problem.
contentCn:
消息队列位于服务之间，让它们无需直接互相调用即可通信。生产者写入一条消息后立即返回，消费者稍后按自己的节奏读取。

这种解耦带来三个实际好处。它能削平流量尖峰，因为队列会缓冲任务，而不是把压力直接灌给下游服务。它提升可靠性：暂时宕机的消费者可以在恢复后继续处理积压的消息。它还支持扇出（fan-out）——多个互不相干的消费者可以对同一个事件做出反应，而生产者对此毫不知情。

代价则是最终一致性与额外的运维负担：你现在必须考虑重复消息、顺序和失败处理。面试官青睐那些能同时讲清两面、并指出队列是异步与缓冲的工具、而不是所有耦合问题万能答案的候选人。
titleCn: 为什么要使用消息队列

title: Kafka versus RabbitMQ
contentMd:
Kafka and RabbitMQ are often compared, and the real difference is their model rather than raw speed. Kafka is a distributed log: messages are appended, retained for a configured period, and consumers read them by advancing an offset. Multiple consumer groups can replay the same data independently.

RabbitMQ is a traditional broker focused on routing. Exchanges direct messages to queues using rules, consumers acknowledge individual messages, and the broker deletes a message once it is acknowledged. It excels at complex routing, per-message acknowledgment, and request-reply patterns.

Choose Kafka for event streaming, high throughput, and replayable history. Choose RabbitMQ for task distribution, intricate routing, and low-latency delivery of individual jobs. In an interview, say that Kafka consumers pull and control their own offset while RabbitMQ pushes and tracks acknowledgments, which explains most of the behavioral differences people notice.
contentCn:
Kafka 和 RabbitMQ 经常被拿来对比，但真正的差异在于两者的模型，而非单纯的速度。Kafka 是一个分布式日志（log）：消息被追加写入、按配置保留一段时间，消费者通过推进偏移量（offset）来读取。多个消费者组可以各自独立地重放同一份数据。

RabbitMQ 则是专注路由的传统消息代理（broker）。交换机（exchange）按规则把消息投递到队列，消费者逐条确认（acknowledge），被确认后消息即被删除。它擅长复杂路由、逐条确认以及请求-响应模式。

事件流、高吞吐、可重放历史的场景选 Kafka；任务分发、复杂路由、单条任务低延迟投递的场景选 RabbitMQ。面试时可以点明：Kafka 的消费者是拉取模式并自行管理 offset，而 RabbitMQ 是推送模式并由 broker 跟踪确认，这一点解释了人们日常感受到的大部分行为差异。

title: Idempotent Message Consumption
contentMd:
A queue usually guarantees that a message is delivered at least once, which means the same message can arrive twice. Any consumer that is not idempotent will corrupt data on redelivery.

The usual defense is an idempotency key. The consumer records the message identifier in a table with a unique constraint before doing work; if the insert fails because the key already exists, the message has been handled and the consumer simply acknowledges and returns. An alternative is to make the operation naturally idempotent by setting absolute values rather than incrementing, or by using a database upsert.

Distributed locks are a weaker option because a lock only serializes concurrent processing and does not protect against a redelivery that happens after the lock is gone. Interviewers want to hear that idempotency is a property of the consumer write, that the deduplication record must be committed in the same transaction as the business change, and that downstream effects such as sending emails should be tracked separately.
contentCn:
消息队列通常只保证至少一次投递，这意味着同一条消息可能重复到达。任何不具备幂等性的消费者都会在重投时把数据搞坏。

常规防御手段是幂等键（idempotency key）。消费者在真正干活之前，先把消息标识写入一张带唯一约束的表；如果因为键已存在而插入失败，说明这条消息已处理过，消费者直接确认并返回即可。另一种思路是让操作本身天然幂等：用设置绝对值替代累加，或者使用数据库的 upsert。

分布式锁是较弱的选项，因为锁只能串行化并发处理，却挡不住锁释放之后才发生的重投。面试官想听到的是：幂等性是消费者写入操作的属性；去重记录必须与业务变更在同一个事务里提交；而发邮件这类下游副作用需要单独跟踪。

title: End-to-End Message Reliability
contentMd:
Reliable messaging has three separate questions: does the producer write survive, does the broker keep it, and does the consumer handle it. Losing sight of any one of them produces silent data loss.

On the producer side, enable acknowledgments from the broker and retry with backoff on failure. On the broker, persist messages to disk and replicate to multiple nodes before acknowledging. On the consumer, process the message first and commit the offset only after the work succeeds; committing first risks losing the message if processing then crashes.

Because retries and at-least-once delivery both create duplicates, reliability is only complete once the consumer is idempotent. Monitoring matters too: track lag between the latest produced offset and the consumer committed offset, and alert when it grows, because growing lag is the earliest sign that consumers cannot keep up.
contentCn:
可靠的消息传递包含三个独立问题：生产者的写入能否保住、代理（broker）能否留存、消费者能否正确处理。忽略其中任何一环都会造成静默的数据丢失。

生产者侧要开启 broker 的确认（ack），并在失败时带退避地重试。Broker 侧要在确认之前把消息持久化到磁盘，并复制到多个节点。消费者侧应当先处理消息、仅在业务处理成功之后再提交 offset；若先提交再处理，一旦处理过程崩溃，这条消息就永久丢失了。

由于重试和至少一次投递都会带来重复消息，可靠性只有在消费者做到幂等之后才算完整。监控同样重要：跟踪最新生产 offset 与消费者已提交 offset 之间的滞后（lag），并在其持续增长时告警，因为 lag 变大是消费者跟不上的最早信号。

title: Handling Message Backlog
contentMd:
When producers outpace consumers, messages pile up. This backlog is the queue doing its job, but unbounded growth eventually exhausts disk and delays every message in the system.

The first response is to scale consumers, usually by adding instances within the same consumer group so partitions are redistributed. Note the ceiling: with a partitioned log you cannot usefully have more consuming instances than partitions, so partition count is a design decision made early. Batching is the second lever, since processing a batch amortizes per-message overhead and raises throughput substantially.

If the backlog still grows, apply backpressure at the source by rate limiting producers, dropping low-value messages, or moving the overflow to a dead-letter destination. Interviewers appreciate the observation that a queue converts a performance problem into a capacity-planning problem, and that the real fix is usually throughput, not a larger buffer.
contentCn:
当生产速度超过消费速度时，消息就会堆积。积压本身正是队列在发挥作用，但无节制的增长最终会耗尽磁盘，并拖慢系统里的每一条消息。

第一反应是扩容消费者，通常是在同一个消费者组内增加实例，让分区被重新分配。要注意天花板：对于分区日志而言，消费实例数超过分区数就不再有收益，所以分区数量是一个必须提前做的设计决策。批处理是第二个杠杆，因为批量处理能摊薄每条消息的固定开销，显著提升吞吐。

如果积压仍在增长，就要在源头施加背压：对生产者限流、丢弃低价值消息，或把溢出部分转到死信目的地。面试官会欣赏这样的观察——队列把一个性能问题转化成了容量规划问题，而真正的解法通常是提升吞吐，而不是把缓冲区加大。

title: Dead-Letter Queues and Retries
contentMd:
A dead-letter queue receives messages that could not be processed successfully. Instead of blocking the pipeline or discarding the data, the broker moves the problematic message aside after a configured number of failed attempts.

Using one requires discipline. The original message must retain its payload and headers so an engineer can inspect why it failed, and the failure reason should be recorded alongside. Because a poison message often reveals a bug, the dead-letter destination needs monitoring and alerting rather than silent accumulation.

Retries should be bounded and usually exponential, with a maximum attempt count before the message is dead-lettered. Immediate infinite retry can lock up a consumer on a single bad message and stall the whole partition. In an interview, mention that dead-letter queues turn invisible failures into a visible, countable backlog that a team can triage and replay after fixing the bug.
contentCn:
